203void Slice::inheritFromPicHeader( PicHeader *picHeader, const PPS *pps, const SPS *sps )
204{
205 if (pps->getRplInfoInPhFlag())
206 {
207 setRPL0idx( picHeader->getRPL0idx() );
208 m_RPL0 = *picHeader->getRPL0();
209 if(getRPL0idx() != -1)
210 {
211 m_RPL0 = *sps->getRPLList0()->getReferencePictureList(getRPL0idx());
212 }
213
214 setRPL1idx( picHeader->getRPL1idx() );
215 m_RPL1 = *picHeader->getRPL1();
216 if(getRPL1idx() != -1)
217 {
218 m_RPL1 = *sps->getRPLList1()->getReferencePictureList(getRPL1idx());
219 }
220 }
221
222 setDeblockingFilterDisable( picHeader->getDeblockingFilterDisable() );
223 setDeblockingFilterBetaOffsetDiv2( picHeader->getDeblockingFilterBetaOffsetDiv2() );
224 setDeblockingFilterTcOffsetDiv2( picHeader->getDeblockingFilterTcOffsetDiv2() );
225 if (pps->getPPSChromaToolFlag())
226 {
227 setDeblockingFilterCbBetaOffsetDiv2 ( picHeader->getDeblockingFilterCbBetaOffsetDiv2() );
228 setDeblockingFilterCbTcOffsetDiv2 ( picHeader->getDeblockingFilterCbTcOffsetDiv2() );
229 setDeblockingFilterCrBetaOffsetDiv2 ( picHeader->getDeblockingFilterCrBetaOffsetDiv2() );
230 setDeblockingFilterCrTcOffsetDiv2 ( picHeader->getDeblockingFilterCrTcOffsetDiv2() );
231 }
232 else
233 {
234 setDeblockingFilterCbBetaOffsetDiv2 ( getDeblockingFilterBetaOffsetDiv2() );
235 setDeblockingFilterCbTcOffsetDiv2 ( getDeblockingFilterTcOffsetDiv2() );
236 setDeblockingFilterCrBetaOffsetDiv2 ( getDeblockingFilterBetaOffsetDiv2() );
237 setDeblockingFilterCrTcOffsetDiv2 ( getDeblockingFilterTcOffsetDiv2() );
238 }
239
240 setSaoEnabledFlag(CHANNEL_TYPE_LUMA, picHeader->getSaoEnabledFlag(CHANNEL_TYPE_LUMA));
241 setSaoEnabledFlag(CHANNEL_TYPE_CHROMA, picHeader->getSaoEnabledFlag(CHANNEL_TYPE_CHROMA));
242
243 setTileGroupAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Y, picHeader->getAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Y));
244 setTileGroupAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cb, picHeader->getAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cb));
245 setTileGroupAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cr, picHeader->getAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cr));
246 setTileGroupNumAps(picHeader->getNumAlfAps());
247 setAlfAPSs(picHeader->getAlfAPSs());
248 setTileGroupApsIdChroma(picHeader->getAlfApsIdChroma());
249 setTileGroupCcAlfCbEnabledFlag(picHeader->getCcAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cb));
250 setTileGroupCcAlfCrEnabledFlag(picHeader->getCcAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cr));
251 setTileGroupCcAlfCbApsId(picHeader->getCcAlfCbApsId());
252 setTileGroupCcAlfCrApsId(picHeader->getCcAlfCrApsId());
253 m_ccAlfFilterParam.ccAlfFilterEnabled[COMPONENT_Cb - 1] = picHeader->getCcAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cb);
254 m_ccAlfFilterParam.ccAlfFilterEnabled[COMPONENT_Cr - 1] = picHeader->getCcAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cr);
255}

257void Slice::setNumSubstream(const SPS* sps, const PPS* pps)
258{
259 uint32_t ctuAddr, ctuX, ctuY;
260 m_numSubstream = 0;
261
262 // count the number of CTUs that align with either the start of a tile, or with an entropy coding sync point
263 // ignore the first CTU since it doesn't count as an entry point
264 for (uint32_t i = 1; i < m_sliceMap.getNumCtuInSlice(); i++)
265 {
266 ctuAddr = m_sliceMap.getCtuAddrInSlice(i);
267 ctuX = (ctuAddr % pps->getPicWidthInCtu());
268 ctuY = (ctuAddr / pps->getPicWidthInCtu());
269
270 if (pps->ctuIsTileColBd(ctuX) && (pps->ctuIsTileRowBd(ctuY) || sps->getEntropyCodingSyncEnabledFlag()))
271 {
272 m_numSubstream++;
273 }
274 }
275}
276
277void Slice::setNumEntryPoints(const SPS *sps, const PPS *pps)
278{
279 uint32_t ctuAddr, ctuX, ctuY;
280 uint32_t prevCtuAddr, prevCtuX, prevCtuY;
281 m_numEntryPoints = 0;
282
283 if (!sps->getEntryPointsPresentFlag())
284 {
285 return;
286 }
287
288 // count the number of CTUs that align with either the start of a tile, or with an entropy coding sync point
289 // ignore the first CTU since it doesn't count as an entry point
290 for( uint32_t i = 1; i < m_sliceMap.getNumCtuInSlice(); i++ )
291 {
292 ctuAddr = m_sliceMap.getCtuAddrInSlice( i );
293 ctuX = ( ctuAddr % pps->getPicWidthInCtu() );
294 ctuY = ( ctuAddr / pps->getPicWidthInCtu() );
295 prevCtuAddr = m_sliceMap.getCtuAddrInSlice(i - 1);
296 prevCtuX = (prevCtuAddr % pps->getPicWidthInCtu());
297 prevCtuY = (prevCtuAddr / pps->getPicWidthInCtu());
298
299 if (pps->ctuToTileRowBd(ctuY) != pps->ctuToTileRowBd(prevCtuY) || pps->ctuToTileColBd(ctuX) != pps->ctuToTileColBd(prevCtuX) || (ctuY != prevCtuY && sps->getEntropyCodingSyncEnabledFlag()))
300 {
301 m_numEntryPoints++;
302 }
303 }
304}

306void Slice::setDefaultClpRng( const SPS& sps )
307{
308 m_clpRngs.comp[COMPONENT_Y].min = m_clpRngs.comp[COMPONENT_Cb].min = m_clpRngs.comp[COMPONENT_Cr].min = 0;
309 m_clpRngs.comp[COMPONENT_Y].max = (1<< sps.getBitDepth(CHANNEL_TYPE_LUMA))-1;
310 m_clpRngs.comp[COMPONENT_Y].bd = sps.getBitDepth(CHANNEL_TYPE_LUMA);
311 m_clpRngs.comp[COMPONENT_Y].n = 0;
312 m_clpRngs.comp[COMPONENT_Cb].max = m_clpRngs.comp[COMPONENT_Cr].max = (1<< sps.getBitDepth(CHANNEL_TYPE_CHROMA))-1;
313 m_clpRngs.comp[COMPONENT_Cb].bd = m_clpRngs.comp[COMPONENT_Cr].bd = sps.getBitDepth(CHANNEL_TYPE_CHROMA);
314 m_clpRngs.comp[COMPONENT_Cb].n = m_clpRngs.comp[COMPONENT_Cr].n = 0;
315 m_clpRngs.used = m_clpRngs.chroma = false;
316}

326void Slice::sortPicList(PicList &picList)
327{
328 picList.sort([](Picture *const &a, Picture *const &b) {
329 return a->getPOC() < b->getPOC() || (a->getPOC() == b->getPOC() && a->layerId < b->layerId);
330 });
331}

333Picture* Slice::xGetRefPic( PicList& rcListPic, const int poc, const int layerId )
334{
335 // return a nullptr, if picture is not found
336 Picture* refPic = nullptr;
337
338 for ( auto &currPic : rcListPic )
339 {
340 if( currPic->getPOC() == poc && currPic->layerId == layerId )
341 {
342 refPic = currPic;
343 break;
344 }
345 }
346 return refPic;
347}
348
349Picture* Slice::xGetLongTermRefPic( PicList& rcListPic, const int poc, const bool pocHasMsb, const int layerId )
350{
351 // return a nullptr, if picture is not found or the found picture is not long-term
352 Picture* refPic = nullptr;
353 const int pocCycle = 1 << getSPS()->getBitsForPOC();
354
355 const int refPoc = pocHasMsb ? poc : (poc & (pocCycle - 1));
356
357 for ( auto &currPic : rcListPic )
358 {
359 if( currPic->getPOC() != this->getPOC() && currPic->referenced && currPic->layerId == layerId )
360 {
361 int currPicPoc = pocHasMsb ? currPic->getPOC() : (currPic->getPOC() & (pocCycle - 1));
362 if (refPoc == currPicPoc)
363 {
364 if(currPic->longTerm)
365 {
366 refPic = currPic;
367 }
368 break;
369 }
370 }
371 }
372
373 return refPic;
374}
375
376Picture* Slice::xGetLongTermRefPicCandidate( PicList& rcListPic, const int poc, const bool pocHasMsb, const int layerId )
377{
378 // return a nullptr, if picture is not found (might be a short-term or a long-term)
379 Picture* refPic = nullptr;
380 const int pocCycle = 1 << getSPS()->getBitsForPOC();
381
382 const int refPoc = pocHasMsb ? poc : (poc & (pocCycle - 1));
383
384 for ( auto &currPic : rcListPic )
385 {
386 if( currPic->getPOC() != this->getPOC() && currPic->referenced && currPic->layerId == layerId )
387 {
388 int currPicPoc = pocHasMsb ? currPic->getPOC() : (currPic->getPOC() & (pocCycle - 1));
389 if (refPoc == currPicPoc)
390 {
391 refPic = currPic;
392 break;
393 }
394 }
395 }
396
397 return refPic;
398}

429void Slice::constructRefPicList(PicList& rcListPic)
430{
431 ::memset(m_bIsUsedAsLongTerm, 0, sizeof(m_bIsUsedAsLongTerm));
432 if (m_eSliceType == I_SLICE)
433 {
434 ::memset(m_apcRefPicList, 0, sizeof(m_apcRefPicList));
435 ::memset(m_aiNumRefIdx, 0, sizeof(m_aiNumRefIdx));
436 return;
437 }
438
439 Picture* pcRefPic = NULL;
440 uint32_t numOfActiveRef = 0;
441 //construct L0
442 numOfActiveRef = getNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_0);
443 int layerIdx = m_pcPic->cs->vps == nullptr ? 0 : m_pcPic->cs->vps->getGeneralLayerIdx( m_pcPic->layerId );
444
445 for (int ii = 0; ii < m_RPL0.getNumRefEntries(); ii++)
446 {
447 if( m_RPL0.isInterLayerRefPic( ii ) )
448 {
449 CHECK( m_RPL0.getInterLayerRefPicIdx( ii ) == NOT_VALID, "Wrong ILRP index" );
450
451 int refLayerId = m_pcPic->cs->vps->getLayerId( m_pcPic->cs->vps->getDirectRefLayerIdx( layerIdx, m_RPL0.getInterLayerRefPicIdx( ii ) ) );
452
453 pcRefPic = xGetRefPic( rcListPic, getPOC(), refLayerId );
454 pcRefPic->longTerm = true;
455 }
456 else
457 if (!m_RPL0.isRefPicLongterm(ii))
458 {
459 pcRefPic = xGetRefPic(rcListPic, getPOC() + m_RPL0.getRefPicIdentifier(ii), m_pcPic->layerId);
460 pcRefPic->longTerm = false;
461 }
462 else
463 {
464 int pocBits = getSPS()->getBitsForPOC();
465 int pocMask = (1 << pocBits) - 1;
466 int ltrpPoc = m_RPL0.getRefPicIdentifier(ii) & pocMask;
467 if(m_RPL0.getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(ii))
468 {
469 ltrpPoc += getPOC() - m_RPL0.getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(ii) * (pocMask + 1) - (getPOC() & pocMask);
470 }
471 pcRefPic = xGetLongTermRefPicCandidate( rcListPic, ltrpPoc, m_RPL0.getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag( ii ), m_pcPic->layerId );
472 pcRefPic->longTerm = true;
473 }
474 if(ii < numOfActiveRef)
475 {
476 pcRefPic->extendPicBorder( getPPS() );
477 m_apcRefPicList[REF_PIC_LIST_0][ii] = pcRefPic;
478 m_bIsUsedAsLongTerm[REF_PIC_LIST_0][ii] = pcRefPic->longTerm;
479 }
480 }
481
482 //construct L1
483 numOfActiveRef = getNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_1);
484 for (int ii = 0; ii < m_RPL1.getNumRefEntries(); ii++)
485 {
486 if( m_RPL1.isInterLayerRefPic( ii ) )
487 {
488 CHECK( m_RPL1.getInterLayerRefPicIdx( ii ) == NOT_VALID, "Wrong ILRP index" );
489
490 int refLayerId = m_pcPic->cs->vps->getLayerId( m_pcPic->cs->vps->getDirectRefLayerIdx( layerIdx, m_RPL1.getInterLayerRefPicIdx( ii ) ) );
491
492 pcRefPic = xGetRefPic( rcListPic, getPOC(), refLayerId );
493 pcRefPic->longTerm = true;
494 }
495 else
496 if (!m_RPL1.isRefPicLongterm(ii))
497 {
498 pcRefPic = xGetRefPic(rcListPic, getPOC() + m_RPL1.getRefPicIdentifier(ii), m_pcPic->layerId);
499 pcRefPic->longTerm = false;
500 }
501 else
502 {
503 int pocBits = getSPS()->getBitsForPOC();
504 int pocMask = (1 << pocBits) - 1;
505 int ltrpPoc = m_RPL1.getRefPicIdentifier(ii) & pocMask;
506 if(m_RPL1.getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(ii))
507 {
508 ltrpPoc += getPOC() - m_RPL1.getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(ii) * (pocMask + 1) - (getPOC() & pocMask);
509 }
510 pcRefPic = xGetLongTermRefPicCandidate( rcListPic, ltrpPoc, m_RPL1.getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag( ii ), m_pcPic->layerId );
511 pcRefPic->longTerm = true;
512 }
513 if(ii < numOfActiveRef)
514 {
515 pcRefPic->extendPicBorder( getPPS() );
516 m_apcRefPicList[REF_PIC_LIST_1][ii] = pcRefPic;
517 m_bIsUsedAsLongTerm[REF_PIC_LIST_1][ii] = pcRefPic->longTerm;
518 }
519 }
520}

522void Slice::initEqualRef()
523{
524 for (int iDir = 0; iDir < NUM_REF_PIC_LIST_01; iDir++)
525 {
526 for (int iRefIdx1 = 0; iRefIdx1 < MAX_NUM_REF; iRefIdx1++)
527 {
528 for (int iRefIdx2 = iRefIdx1; iRefIdx2 < MAX_NUM_REF; iRefIdx2++)
529 {
530 m_abEqualRef[iDir][iRefIdx1][iRefIdx2] = m_abEqualRef[iDir][iRefIdx2][iRefIdx1] = (iRefIdx1 == iRefIdx2? true : false);
531 }
532 }
533 }

536void Slice::checkColRefIdx(uint32_t curSliceSegmentIdx, const Picture* pic)
537{
538 int i;
539 Slice* curSlice = pic->slices[curSliceSegmentIdx];
540 int currColRefPOC = curSlice->getRefPOC( RefPicList(1 - curSlice->getColFromL0Flag()), curSlice->getColRefIdx());
541
542 for(i=curSliceSegmentIdx-1; i>=0; i--)
543 {
544 const Slice* preSlice = pic->slices[i];
545 if(preSlice->getSliceType() != I_SLICE)
546 {
547 const int preColRefPOC = preSlice->getRefPOC( RefPicList(1 - preSlice->getColFromL0Flag()), preSlice->getColRefIdx());
548 if(currColRefPOC != preColRefPOC)
549 {
550 THROW("sh_collocated_ref_idx shall always be the same for all slices of a coded picture!");
551 }
552 else
553 {
554 break;
555 }
556 }
557 }
558}

560void Slice::checkCRA(const ReferencePictureList* pRPL0, const ReferencePictureList* pRPL1, const int pocCRA, PicList& rcListPic)
561{
562 if (pocCRA < MAX_UINT && getPOC() > pocCRA)
563 {
564 uint32_t numRefPic = pRPL0->getNumberOfShorttermPictures() + pRPL0->getNumberOfLongtermPictures();
565 for (int i = 0; i < numRefPic; i++)
566 {
567 if (!pRPL0->isRefPicLongterm(i))
568 {
569 CHECK(getPOC() + pRPL0->getRefPicIdentifier(i) < pocCRA, "Invalid state");
570 }
571 else if (!pRPL0->isInterLayerRefPic(i))
572 {
573 int pocBits = getSPS()->getBitsForPOC();
574 int pocMask = (1 << pocBits) - 1;
575 int ltrpPoc = pRPL0->getRefPicIdentifier(i) & pocMask;
576 if(pRPL0->getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(i))
577 {
578 ltrpPoc += getPOC() - pRPL0->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i) * (pocMask + 1) - (getPOC() & pocMask);
579 }
580 const Picture *ltrp =
581 xGetLongTermRefPic(rcListPic, ltrpPoc, pRPL0->getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(i), m_pcPic->layerId);
582 CHECK(ltrp == nullptr, "Long-term pic not found");
583 CHECK(ltrp->getPOC() < pocCRA, "Invalid state");
584 }
585 }
586 numRefPic = pRPL1->getNumberOfShorttermPictures() + pRPL1->getNumberOfLongtermPictures();
587 for (int i = 0; i < numRefPic; i++)
588 {
589 if (!pRPL1->isRefPicLongterm(i))
590 {
591 CHECK(getPOC() + pRPL1->getRefPicIdentifier(i) < pocCRA, "Invalid state");
592 }
593 else if( !pRPL1->isInterLayerRefPic( i ) )
594 {
595 int pocBits = getSPS()->getBitsForPOC();
596 int pocMask = (1 << pocBits) - 1;
597 int ltrpPoc = pRPL1->getRefPicIdentifier(i) & pocMask;
598 if(pRPL1->getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(i))
599 {
600 ltrpPoc += getPOC() - pRPL1->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i) * (pocMask + 1) - (getPOC() & pocMask);
601 }
602 const Picture *ltrp =
603 xGetLongTermRefPic(rcListPic, ltrpPoc, pRPL1->getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(i), m_pcPic->layerId);
604 CHECK(ltrp == nullptr, "Long-term pic not found");
605 CHECK(ltrp->getPOC() < pocCRA, "Invalid state");
606 }
607 }
608 }
609}
610
611void Slice::checkRPL(const ReferencePictureList* pRPL0, const ReferencePictureList* pRPL1, const int associatedIRAPDecodingOrderNumber, PicList& rcListPic)
612{
613 Picture* pcRefPic;
614 int refPicPOC;
615 int refPicDecodingOrderNumber;
616
617 int irapPOC = getAssociatedIRAPPOC();
618
619 const int numEntries[] = { pRPL0->getNumberOfShorttermPictures() + pRPL0->getNumberOfLongtermPictures() + pRPL0->getNumberOfInterLayerPictures(), pRPL1->getNumberOfShorttermPictures() + pRPL1->getNumberOfLongtermPictures() + pRPL1->getNumberOfInterLayerPictures() };
620 const int numActiveEntries[] = { getNumRefIdx( REF_PIC_LIST_0 ), getNumRefIdx( REF_PIC_LIST_1 ) };
621 const ReferencePictureList* rpl[] = { pRPL0, pRPL1 };
622 const bool fieldSeqFlag = getSPS()->getFieldSeqFlag();
623 const int layerIdx = m_pcPic->cs->vps == nullptr ? 0 : m_pcPic->cs->vps->getGeneralLayerIdx( m_pcPic->layerId );
624
625 for( int refPicList = 0; refPicList < 2; refPicList++ )
626 {
627 for( int i = 0; i < numEntries[refPicList]; i++ )
628 {
629 if( rpl[refPicList]->isInterLayerRefPic( i ) )
630 {
631 int refLayerId = m_pcPic->cs->vps->getLayerId( m_pcPic->cs->vps->getDirectRefLayerIdx( layerIdx, rpl[refPicList]->getInterLayerRefPicIdx( i ) ) );
632 pcRefPic = xGetRefPic( rcListPic, getPOC(), refLayerId );
633 refPicPOC = pcRefPic->getPOC();
634 }
635 else if( !rpl[refPicList]->isRefPicLongterm( i ) )
636 {
637 refPicPOC = getPOC() + rpl[refPicList]->getRefPicIdentifier(i);
638 pcRefPic = xGetRefPic( rcListPic, refPicPOC, m_pcPic->layerId );
639 }
640 else
641 {
642 int pocBits = getSPS()->getBitsForPOC();
643 int pocMask = ( 1 << pocBits ) - 1;
644 int ltrpPoc = rpl[refPicList]->getRefPicIdentifier( i ) & pocMask;
645 if( rpl[refPicList]->getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag( i ) )
646 {
647 ltrpPoc += getPOC() - rpl[refPicList]->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT( i ) * ( pocMask + 1 ) - ( getPOC() & pocMask );
648 }
649 pcRefPic = xGetLongTermRefPic( rcListPic, ltrpPoc, rpl[refPicList]->getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag( i ), m_pcPic->layerId );
650 refPicPOC = pcRefPic->getPOC();
651 }
652 if (pcRefPic) // the checks are for all reference picture, but we may not have an inactive reference picture, if starting with a CRA
653 {
654 refPicDecodingOrderNumber = pcRefPic->getDecodingOrderNumber();
655
656 if( m_eNalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_CRA || m_eNalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_W_RADL || m_eNalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_N_LP )
657 {
658 CHECK( refPicPOC < irapPOC || refPicDecodingOrderNumber < associatedIRAPDecodingOrderNumber, "When the current picture, with nuh_layer_id equal to a particular value layerId, "
659 "is an IRAP picture, there shall be no picture referred to by an entry in RefPicList[ 0 ] that precedes, in output order or decoding order, any preceding IRAP picture "
660 "with nuh_layer_id equal to layerId in decoding order (when present)." );
661 }
662
663 if( irapPOC < getPOC() && !fieldSeqFlag )
664 {
665 CHECK( refPicPOC < irapPOC || refPicDecodingOrderNumber < associatedIRAPDecodingOrderNumber, "When the current picture follows an IRAP picture having the same value "
666 "of nuh_layer_id and the leading pictures, if any, associated with that IRAP picture, in both decoding order and output order, there shall be no picture referred "
667 "to by an entry in RefPicList[ 0 ] or RefPicList[ 1 ] that precedes that IRAP picture in output order or decoding order." );
668 }
669
670 // Generated reference picture does not have picture header
671 const bool isGeneratedRefPic = pcRefPic->slices[0]->getPicHeader() ? false : true;
672
673 const bool nonReferencePictureFlag = isGeneratedRefPic ? pcRefPic->slices[0]->getPicHeader()->getNonReferencePictureFlag() : pcRefPic->nonReferencePictureFlag;
674 CHECK( pcRefPic == m_pcPic || nonReferencePictureFlag, "The picture referred to by each entry in RefPicList[ 0 ] or RefPicList[ 1 ] shall not be the current picture and shall have ph_non_ref_pic_flag equal to 0" );
675
676 if( i < numActiveEntries[refPicList] )
677 {
678 if( irapPOC < getPOC() )
679 {
680 CHECK( refPicPOC < irapPOC || refPicDecodingOrderNumber < associatedIRAPDecodingOrderNumber, "When the current picture follows an IRAP picture having the same value "
681 "of nuh_layer_id in both decoding order and output order, there shall be no picture referred to by an active entry in RefPicList[ 0 ] or RefPicList[ 1 ] that "
682 "precedes that IRAP picture in output order or decoding order." );
683 }
684
685 // Checking this: "When the current picture is a RADL picture, there shall be no active entry in RefPicList[ 0 ] or
686 // RefPicList[ 1 ] that is any of the following: A picture that precedes the associated IRAP picture in decoding order"
687 if( m_eNalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RADL )
688 {
689 CHECK( refPicDecodingOrderNumber < associatedIRAPDecodingOrderNumber, "RADL picture detected that violate the rule that no active entry in RefPicList[] shall precede the associated IRAP picture in decoding order" );
690#if JVET_S0084_S0110_RADL
691 // Checking this: "When the current picture is a RADL picture, there shall be no active entry in RefPicList[ 0 ] or
692 // RefPicList[ 1 ] that is any of the following: A RASL picture with pps_mixed_nalu_types_in_pic_flag is equal to 0
693 for (int i = 0; i < pcRefPic->numSlices; i++)
694 {
695 if (pcRefPic->slices[i]->getPPS()->getMixedNaluTypesInPicFlag() == 0)
696 {
697 CHECK(pcRefPic->slices[i]->getNalUnitType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RASL, "When the current picture is a RADL picture, there shall be no active entry in RefPicList[ 0 ] or RefPicList[ 1 ] that is a RASL picture with pps_mixed_nalu_types_in_pic_flag is equal to 0");
698 }
699 }
700#endif
701
702 }
703
704 CHECK( pcRefPic->temporalId > m_pcPic->temporalId, "The picture referred to by each active entry in RefPicList[ 0 ] or RefPicList[ 1 ] shall be present in the DPB and shall have TemporalId less than or equal to that of the current picture." );
705 }
706#if JVET_R0046_IRAP_ASPECT2
707 // Add a constraint on an ILRP being either an IRAP picture or having TemporalId less than or equal to
708 // Max (0, vps_max_tid_il_ref_pics_plus1[ refPicVpsLayerId ] - 1 ), with refPicVpsLayerId equal to the value of
709 // the nuh_layer_id of the referenced picture.
710 if (rpl[refPicList]->isInterLayerRefPic(i))
711 {
712 bool cond1 = (pcRefPic->getPictureType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_GDR);
713 bool cond2 = (pcRefPic->slices[0]->getPicHeader()->getRecoveryPocCnt() == 0);
714 bool cond3 = (pcRefPic->cs->slice->isIRAP());
715
716 const VPS *vps = pcRefPic->cs->vps;
717 const int maxTidILRefPicsPlus1 = vps->getMaxTidIlRefPicsPlus1(layerIdx, pcRefPic->layerId);
718 bool cond4 = (pcRefPic->temporalId < maxTidILRefPicsPlus1);
719
720 CHECK((cond1 && cond2) || cond3 || cond4,
721 "Either of the following conditions shall apply for the picture referred to by each ILRP entry, when "
722 "present, in RefPicList[ 0 ] or RefPicList[ 1 ] of a slice of the current picture:-The picture is a "
723 "GDR picture with "
724 "ph_recovery_poc_cnt equal to 0 or an IRAP picture."
725 "-The picture has TemporalId less than vps_max_tid_il_ref_pics_plus1[ currLayerIdx ][ refLayerIdx ], "
726 "where currLayerIdx and refLayerIdx are equal to "
727 "GeneralLayerIdx[ nuh_layer_id ] and GeneralLayerIdx[ refpicLayerId ], respectively. ");
728 }
729#endif
730 }
731 }
732 }
733}
734
735void Slice::checkSTSA(PicList& rcListPic)
736{
737 int ii;
738 Picture* pcRefPic = NULL;
739 int numOfActiveRef = getNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_0);
740
741 for (ii = 0; ii < numOfActiveRef; ii++)
742 {
743 pcRefPic = m_apcRefPicList[REF_PIC_LIST_0][ii];
744
745 if( m_eNalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_STSA && pcRefPic->layerId == m_pcPic->layerId )
746 {
747 CHECK( pcRefPic->temporalId == m_uiTLayer, "When the current picture is an STSA picture and nuh_layer_id equal to that of the current picture, there shall be no active entry in the RPL that has TemporalId equal to that of the current picture" );
748 }
749
750 // Checking this: "When the current picture is a picture that follows, in decoding order, an STSA picture that has TemporalId equal to that of the current picture, there shall be no
751 // picture that has TemporalId equal to that of the current picture included as an active entry in RefPicList[ 0 ] or RefPicList[ 1 ] that precedes the STSA picture in decoding order."
752 CHECK(pcRefPic->subLayerNonReferencePictureDueToSTSA, "The RPL of the current picture contains a picture that is not allowed in this temporal layer due to an earlier STSA picture");
753 }
754
755 numOfActiveRef = getNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_1);
756 for (ii = 0; ii < numOfActiveRef; ii++)
757 {
758 pcRefPic = m_apcRefPicList[REF_PIC_LIST_1][ii];
759
760 if( m_eNalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_STSA && pcRefPic->layerId == m_pcPic->layerId )
761 {
762 CHECK( pcRefPic->temporalId == m_uiTLayer, "When the current picture is an STSA picture and nuh_layer_id equal to that of the current picture, there shall be no active entry in the RPL that has TemporalId equal to that of the current picture" );
763 }
764
765 // Checking this: "When the current picture is a picture that follows, in decoding order, an STSA picture that has TemporalId equal to that of the current picture, there shall be no
766 // picture that has TemporalId equal to that of the current picture included as an active entry in RefPicList[ 0 ] or RefPicList[ 1 ] that precedes the STSA picture in decoding order."
767 CHECK(pcRefPic->subLayerNonReferencePictureDueToSTSA, "The active RPL part of the current picture contains a picture that is not allowed in this temporal layer due to an earlier STSA picture");
768 }
769
770 // If the current picture is an STSA picture, make all reference pictures in the DPB with temporal
771 // id equal to the temproal id of the current picture sub-layer non-reference pictures. The flag
772 // subLayerNonReferencePictureDueToSTSA equal to true means that the picture may not be used for
773 // reference by a picture that follows the current STSA picture in decoding order
774 if (getNalUnitType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_STSA)
775 {
776 PicList::iterator iterPic = rcListPic.begin();
777 while (iterPic != rcListPic.end())
778 {
779 pcRefPic = *(iterPic++);
780 if (!pcRefPic->referenced || pcRefPic->getPOC() == m_iPOC)
781 {
782 continue;
783 }
784
785 if (pcRefPic->temporalId == m_uiTLayer)
786 {
787 pcRefPic->subLayerNonReferencePictureDueToSTSA = true;
788 }
789 }
790 }
791}

793
812void Slice::decodingRefreshMarking(int& pocCRA, bool& bRefreshPending, PicList& rcListPic, const bool bEfficientFieldIRAPEnabled)
813{
814 Picture* rpcPic;
815 int pocCurr = getPOC();
816
817 if ( getNalUnitType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_W_RADL
818 || getNalUnitType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_N_LP) // IDR picture
819 {
820 // mark all pictures as not used for reference
821 PicList::iterator iterPic = rcListPic.begin();
822 while (iterPic != rcListPic.end())
823 {
824 rpcPic = *(iterPic);
825 if (rpcPic->getPOC() != pocCurr)
826 {
827 rpcPic->referenced = false;
828 rpcPic->getHashMap()->clearAll();
829 }
830 iterPic++;
831 }
832 if (bEfficientFieldIRAPEnabled)
833 {
834 bRefreshPending = true;
835 }
836 }
837 else // CRA or No DR
838 {
839 if(bEfficientFieldIRAPEnabled && (getAssociatedIRAPType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_N_LP || getAssociatedIRAPType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_W_RADL))
840 {
841 if (bRefreshPending==true && pocCurr > m_iLastIDR) // IDR reference marking pending
842 {
843 PicList::iterator iterPic = rcListPic.begin();
844 while (iterPic != rcListPic.end())
845 {
846 rpcPic = *(iterPic);
847 if (rpcPic->getPOC() != pocCurr && rpcPic->getPOC() != m_iLastIDR)
848 {
849 rpcPic->referenced = false;
850 rpcPic->getHashMap()->clearAll();
851 }
852 iterPic++;
853 }
854 bRefreshPending = false;
855 }
856 }
857 else
858 {
859 if (bRefreshPending==true && pocCurr > pocCRA) // CRA reference marking pending
860 {
861 PicList::iterator iterPic = rcListPic.begin();
862 while (iterPic != rcListPic.end())
863 {
864 rpcPic = *(iterPic);
865 if (rpcPic->getPOC() != pocCurr && rpcPic->getPOC() != pocCRA)
866 {
867 rpcPic->referenced = false;
868 rpcPic->getHashMap()->clearAll();
869 }
870 iterPic++;
871 }
872 bRefreshPending = false;
873 }
874 }
875 if ( getNalUnitType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_CRA ) // CRA picture found
876 {
877 bRefreshPending = true;
878 pocCRA = pocCurr;
879 }
880 }
881}

1020bool Slice::isTemporalLayerSwitchingPoint(PicList& rcListPic) const
1021{
1022 // loop through all pictures in the reference picture buffer
1023 PicList::iterator iterPic = rcListPic.begin();
1024 while ( iterPic != rcListPic.end())
1025 {
1026 const Picture* pcPic = *(iterPic++);
1027 if( pcPic->referenced && pcPic->poc != getPOC())

1029 if( pcPic->temporalId >= getTLayer())
1030 {
1031 return false;
1032 }
1033 }
1034 }
1035 return true;

1058void Slice::checkLeadingPictureRestrictions(PicList& rcListPic, const PPS& pps) const
1059{
1060 int nalUnitType = this->getNalUnitType();
1061
1062 // When a picture is a leading picture, it shall be a RADL or RASL picture.
1063 if(this->getAssociatedIRAPPOC() > this->getPOC())
1064 {
1065 //check this only when pps_mixed_nalu_types_in_pic_flag is equal to 0
1066 if (pps.getMixedNaluTypesInPicFlag() == 0)
1067 {
1068 // Do not check IRAP pictures since they may get a POC lower than their associated IRAP
1069 if (nalUnitType < NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_W_RADL ||
1070 nalUnitType > NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_CRA)
1071 {
1072 CHECK(nalUnitType != NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RASL &&
1073 nalUnitType != NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RADL, "Invalid NAL unit type");
1074 }
1075 }
1076 }
1077
1078 if (this->getAssociatedIRAPPOC() <= this->getPOC())
1079 {
1080 if (pps.getMixedNaluTypesInPicFlag() == 0)
1081 {
1082 CHECK(nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RASL || nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RADL, "When a picture is not a leading picture, it shall not be a RADL or RASL picture.");
1083 }
1084 }
1085
1086 // No RASL pictures shall be present in the bitstream that are associated with
1087 // an IDR picture.
1088 if (nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RASL && !pps.getMixedNaluTypesInPicFlag())
1089 {
1090 CHECK( this->getAssociatedIRAPType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_N_LP ||
1091 this->getAssociatedIRAPType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_W_RADL, "Invalid NAL unit type");
1092 }
1093
1094 // No RADL pictures shall be present in the bitstream that are associated with
1095 // a BLA picture having nal_unit_type equal to BLA_N_LP or that are associated
1096 // with an IDR picture having nal_unit_type equal to IDR_N_LP.
1097 if (nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RADL && !pps.getMixedNaluTypesInPicFlag())
1098 {
1099 CHECK (this->getAssociatedIRAPType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_N_LP, "Invalid NAL unit type");
1100 }
1101
1102 // loop through all pictures in the reference picture buffer
1103 PicList::iterator iterPic = rcListPic.begin();
1104 int numNonLPFound = 0;
1105 while ( iterPic != rcListPic.end())
1106 {
1107 Picture* pcPic = *(iterPic++);
1108 if( ! pcPic->reconstructed)
1109 {
1110 continue;
1111 }
1112 if( pcPic->poc == this->getPOC())
1113 {
1114 continue;
1115 }
1116 const Slice* pcSlice = pcPic->slices[0];
1117
1118 if (pcSlice->getPicHeader()->getPicOutputFlag() == 1 && !this->getNoOutputOfPriorPicsFlag() && pcPic->layerId == this->m_nuhLayerId)
1119 {
1120 if ((nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_CRA || nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_N_LP || nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_W_RADL) && !pps.getMixedNaluTypesInPicFlag())
1121 {
1122 CHECK(pcPic->poc >= this->getPOC(), "Any picture, with nuh_layer_id equal to a particular value layerId, that precedes an IRAP picture with nuh_layer_id "
1123 "equal to layerId in decoding order shall precede the IRAP picture in output order.");
1124 }
1125 }
1126
1127 if (pcSlice->getPicHeader()->getPicOutputFlag() == 1 && pcPic->layerId == this->m_nuhLayerId)
1128 {
1129 if (nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RADL)
1130 {
1131 if (this->getAssociatedIRAPPOC() > pcSlice->getAssociatedIRAPPOC() && !pps.getMixedNaluTypesInPicFlag())
1132 {
1133 if (this->getAssociatedIRAPPOC() != pcPic->poc)
1134 {
1135 CHECK(pcPic->poc >= this->getPOC(), "Any picture, with nuh_layer_id equal to a particular value layerId, that precedes an IRAP picture with nuh_layer_id "
1136 "equal to layerId in decoding order shall precede any RADL picture associated with the IRAP picture in output order.");
1137 }
1138 }
1139 }
1140 }
1141
1142 if (pcSlice->getPicHeader()->getPicOutputFlag() == 1 && !this->getPicHeader()->getNoOutputBeforeRecoveryFlag() && pcPic->layerId == this->m_nuhLayerId
1143 && nalUnitType != NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_GDR && this->getPicHeader()->getRecoveryPocCnt() != -1)
1144 {
1145 if (this->getPOC() == this->getPicHeader()->getRecoveryPocCnt() + this->getPrevGDRInSameLayerPOC())
1146 {
1147 CHECK(pcPic->poc >= this->getPOC(), "Any picture, with nuh_layer_id equal to a particular value layerId, that precedes a recovery point picture with "
1148 "nuh_layer_id equal to layerId in decoding order shall precede the recovery point picture in output order.");
1149 }
1150 }
1151
1152 if ((nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RASL || nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RADL) &&
1153 (pcSlice->getNalUnitType() != NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RASL && pcSlice->getNalUnitType() != NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RADL) && !pps.getMixedNaluTypesInPicFlag())
1154 {
1155 if (pcSlice->getAssociatedIRAPPOC() == this->getAssociatedIRAPPOC() && pcPic->layerId == this->m_nuhLayerId)
1156 {
1157 numNonLPFound++;
1158 int limitNonLP = 0;
1159 if (pcSlice->getSPS()->getFieldSeqFlag())
1160 {
1161 limitNonLP = 1;
1162 }
1163 CHECK(pcPic->poc > this->getAssociatedIRAPPOC() && numNonLPFound > limitNonLP, "If sps_field_seq_flag is equal to 0 and the current picture, with nuh_layer_id "
1164 "equal to a particular value layerId, is a leading picture associated with an IRAP picture, it shall precede, in decoding order, all non-leading "
1165 "pictures that are associated with the same IRAP picture.Otherwise, let picA and picB be the first and the last leading pictures, in decoding order, "
1166 "associated with an IRAP picture, respectively, there shall be at most one non-leading picture with nuh_layer_id equal to layerId preceding picA in "
1167 "decoding order, and there shall be no non-leading picture with nuh_layer_id equal to layerId between picA and picB in decoding order.");
1168 }
1169 }
1170
1171 if (nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RASL && !pps.getMixedNaluTypesInPicFlag())
1172 {
1173 if ((this->getAssociatedIRAPType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_CRA) &&
1174 this->getAssociatedIRAPPOC() == pcSlice->getAssociatedIRAPPOC())
1175 {
1176 if (pcSlice->getNalUnitType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RADL)
1177 {
1178 CHECK(pcPic->poc <= this->getPOC(), "Any RASL picture associated with a CRA picture shall precede any RADL picture associated with the CRA picture in output order.");
1179 }
1180 }
1181 }
1182
1183 if (nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RASL && !pps.getMixedNaluTypesInPicFlag())
1184 {
1185 if(this->getAssociatedIRAPType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_CRA)
1186 {
1187 if(pcSlice->getPOC() < this->getAssociatedIRAPPOC() &&
1188 (
1189 pcSlice->getNalUnitType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_N_LP ||
1190 pcSlice->getNalUnitType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_W_RADL ||
1191 pcSlice->getNalUnitType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_CRA ||
1192 pcSlice->getNalUnitType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_GDR) &&
1193 pcPic->layerId == this->m_nuhLayerId)
1194 {
1195 CHECK(this->getPOC() <= pcSlice->getPOC(), "Any RASL picture, with nuh_layer_id equal to a particular value layerId, associated with a CRA picture shall follow, "
1196 "in output order, any IRAP or GDR picture with nuh_layer_id equal to layerId that precedes the CRA picture in decoding order.");
1197 }
1198 }
1199 }
1200 }
1201}
1202
1203void Slice::checkSubpicTypeConstraints(PicList& rcListPic, const ReferencePictureList* pRPL0, const ReferencePictureList* pRPL1, const int prevIRAPSubpicDecOrderNo)
1204{
1205 int curSubpicIdx = getPPS()->getSubPicIdxFromSubPicId(getSliceSubPicId());
1206
1207 if (getPPS()->getMixedNaluTypesInPicFlag() && getSliceType() != I_SLICE)
1208 {
1209 CHECK(!getSPS()->getSubPicTreatedAsPicFlag(curSubpicIdx), "When pps_mixed_nalu_types_in_pic_flag is equal 1, the value of sps_subpic_treated_as_pic_flag shall be equal to 1 "
1210 "for all the subpictures that are in the picture and contain at least one P or B slice");
1211 }
1212
1213 int nalUnitType = getNalUnitType();
1214 int prevIRAPSubpicPOC = getPrevIRAPSubpicPOC();
1215
1216 if (getCtuAddrInSlice(0) == getPPS()->getSubPic(curSubpicIdx).getFirstCTUInSubPic())
1217 {
1218 // subpicture type related constraints invoked only if the current slice is the first slice of a subpicture
1219 int prevGDRSubpicPOC = getPrevGDRSubpicPOC();
1220 int prevIRAPSubpicType = getPrevIRAPSubpicType();
1221
1222 if (prevIRAPSubpicPOC > getPOC() && (nalUnitType < NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_W_RADL || nalUnitType > NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_CRA))
1223 {
1224 CHECK(nalUnitType != NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RASL && nalUnitType != NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RADL,
1225 "When a subpicture is a leading subpicture of an IRAP subpicture, it shall be a RADL or RASL subpicture");
1226 }
1227
1228 if (prevIRAPSubpicPOC <= getPOC())
1229 {
1230 CHECK(nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RASL || nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RADL,
1231 "When a subpicture is not a leading subpicture of an IRAP subpicture, it shall not be a RADL or RASL subpicture");
1232 }
1233
1234 CHECK(nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RASL && (prevIRAPSubpicType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_N_LP || prevIRAPSubpicType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_W_RADL),
1235 "No RASL subpictures shall be present in the bitstream that are associated with an IDR subpicture");
1236
1237 CHECK(nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RADL && prevIRAPSubpicType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_N_LP,
1238 "No RADL subpictures shall be present in the bitstream that are associated with an IDR subpicture having nal_unit_type equal to IDR_N_LP");
1239
1240 //constraints related to current subpicture type and its preceding subpicture types
1241 PicList::iterator iterPic = rcListPic.begin();
1242 int numNonLeadingPic = 0;
1243 while (iterPic != rcListPic.end())
1244 {
1245 Picture* bufPic = *(iterPic++);
1246 if (!bufPic->reconstructed)
1247 {
1248 continue;
1249 }
1250 if (bufPic->poc == getPOC())
1251 {
1252 continue;
1253 }
1254
1255 //identify the subpicture in the reference picture buffer that with nuh_layer_id equal to current subpicture layerId and subpicture index equal to current subpicIdx
1256 bool isBufPicOutput = false;
1257 int bufSubpicType = NAL_UNIT_INVALID;
1258 int bufSubpicPrevIRAPSubpicPOC = 0;
1259 for (int i = 0; i < bufPic->numSlices; i++)
1260 {
1261 if (bufPic->sliceSubpicIdx[i] == curSubpicIdx)
1262 {
1263 isBufPicOutput = bufPic->slices[i]->getPicHeader()->getPicOutputFlag();
1264 bufSubpicType = bufPic->slices[i]->getNalUnitType();
1265 bufSubpicPrevIRAPSubpicPOC = bufPic->slices[i]->getPrevIRAPSubpicPOC();
1266 break;
1267 }
1268 }
1269
1270 if ((nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_CRA || nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_N_LP || nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_W_RADL) &&
1271 !this->getNoOutputOfPriorPicsFlag() && isBufPicOutput == 1 && bufPic->layerId == m_nuhLayerId)
1272 {
1273 CHECK(bufPic->poc >= getPOC(), "Any subpicture, with nuh_layer_id equal to a particular value layerId and subpicture index equal to a particular value subpicIdx, that "
1274 "precedes, in decoding order, an IRAP subpicture with nuh_layer_id equal to layerId and subpicture index equal to subpicIdx shall precede, in output order, the "
1275 "IRAP subpicture");
1276 }
1277
1278 if (nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RADL && isBufPicOutput == 1 && bufPic->layerId == m_nuhLayerId &&
1279 prevIRAPSubpicPOC > bufSubpicPrevIRAPSubpicPOC && prevIRAPSubpicPOC != bufPic->poc)
1280 {
1281 CHECK(bufPic->poc >= getPOC(), "Any subpicture, with nuh_layer_id equal to a particular value layerId and subpicture index equal to a particular value subpicIdx, that "
1282 "precedes, in decoding order, an IRAP subpicture with nuh_layer_id equal to layerId and subpicture index equal to subpicIdx shall precede, in output order, all "
1283 "its associated RADL subpictures");
1284 }
1285
1286 if ((getPOC() == getPicHeader()->getRecoveryPocCnt() + prevGDRSubpicPOC) && !this->getNoOutputOfPriorPicsFlag() && isBufPicOutput == 1 &&
1287 bufPic->layerId == m_nuhLayerId && nalUnitType != NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_GDR && getPicHeader()->getRecoveryPocCnt() != -1)
1288 {
1289 CHECK(bufPic->poc >= getPOC(), "Any subpicture, with nuh_layer_id equal to a particular value layerId and subpicture index equal to a particular value subpicIdx, that "
1290 "precedes, in decoding order, a subpicture with nuh_layer_id equal to layerId and subpicture index equal to subpicIdx in a recovery point picture shall precede "
1291 "that subpicture in the recovery point picture in output order");
1292 }
1293
1294 if (nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RASL && prevIRAPSubpicType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_CRA && bufSubpicType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RADL &&
1295 prevIRAPSubpicPOC == bufSubpicPrevIRAPSubpicPOC)
1296 {
1297 CHECK(bufPic->poc <= getPOC(), "Any RASL subpicture associated with a CRA subpicture shall precede any RADL subpicture associated with the CRA subpicture in output order");
1298 }
1299
1300 if (nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RASL && prevIRAPSubpicType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_CRA && bufPic->layerId == m_nuhLayerId && bufPic->poc < prevIRAPSubpicPOC)
1301 {
1302 if (bufSubpicType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_N_LP || bufSubpicType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_W_RADL ||
1303 bufSubpicType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_CRA || bufSubpicType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_GDR)
1304 {
1305 CHECK(bufPic->poc >= getPOC(), "Any RASL subpicture, with nuh_layer_id equal to a particular value layerId and subpicture index equal to a particular value subpicIdx, "
1306 "associated with a CRA subpicture shall follow, in output order, any IRAP or GDR subpicture , with nuh_layer_id equal to layerId and subpicture index equal to "
1307 "subpicIdx, that precedes the CRA subpicture in decoding order");
1308 }
1309 }
1310
1311 if ((nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RASL || nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RADL) &&
1312 bufSubpicType != NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RASL && bufSubpicType != NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RADL &&
1313 bufSubpicPrevIRAPSubpicPOC == prevIRAPSubpicPOC && bufPic->layerId == m_nuhLayerId)
1314 {
1315 numNonLeadingPic++;
1316 int th = bufPic->cs->sps->getFieldSeqFlag() ? 1 : 0;
1317 CHECK(bufPic->poc > prevIRAPSubpicPOC && numNonLeadingPic > th, "If sps_field_seq_flag is equal to 0 and the current subpicture, with nuh_layer_id equal to a particular value "
1318 "layerId and subpicture index equal to a particular value subpicIdx, is a leading subpicture associated with an IRAP subpicture, it shall precede, in decoding order, "
1319 "all non-leading subpictures that are associated with the same IRAP subpicture. Otherwise, let subpicA and subpicB be the first and the last leading subpictures, in "
1320 "decoding order, associated with an IRAP subpicture, respectively, there shall be at most one non-leading subpicture with nuh_layer_id equal to layerId and subpicture "
1321 "index equal to subpicIdx preceding subpicA in decoding order, and there shall be no non-leading picture with nuh_layer_id equal to layerId and subpicture index equal "
1322 "to subpicIdx between picA and picB in decoding order");
1323 }
1324 }
1325 }
1326
1327 //subpic RPL related constraints
1328 Picture* pcRefPic;
1329 int refPicPOC;
1330 int refPicDecodingOrderNumber;
1331
1332 int numEntriesL0 = pRPL0->getNumberOfShorttermPictures() + pRPL0->getNumberOfLongtermPictures() + pRPL0->getNumberOfInterLayerPictures();
1333 int numEntriesL1 = pRPL1->getNumberOfShorttermPictures() + pRPL1->getNumberOfLongtermPictures() + pRPL1->getNumberOfInterLayerPictures();
1334
1335 int numActiveEntriesL0 = getNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_0);
1336 int numActiveEntriesL1 = getNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_1);
1337
1338 int layerIdx = m_pcPic->cs->vps == nullptr ? 0 : m_pcPic->cs->vps->getGeneralLayerIdx(m_pcPic->layerId);
1339 for (int i = 0; i < numEntriesL0; i++)
1340 {
1341 if (pRPL0->isInterLayerRefPic(i))
1342 {
1343 int refLayerId = m_pcPic->cs->vps->getLayerId(m_pcPic->cs->vps->getDirectRefLayerIdx(layerIdx, pRPL0->getInterLayerRefPicIdx(i)));
1344 pcRefPic = xGetRefPic(rcListPic, getPOC(), refLayerId);
1345 refPicPOC = pcRefPic->getPOC();
1346 }
1347 else if (!pRPL0->isRefPicLongterm(i))
1348 {
1349 refPicPOC = getPOC() + pRPL0->getRefPicIdentifier(i);
1350 pcRefPic = xGetRefPic(rcListPic, refPicPOC, m_pcPic->layerId);
1351 }
1352 else
1353 {
1354 int pocBits = getSPS()->getBitsForPOC();
1355 int pocMask = (1 << pocBits) - 1;
1356 int ltrpPoc = pRPL0->getRefPicIdentifier(i) & pocMask;
1357 if(pRPL0->getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(i))
1358 {
1359 ltrpPoc += getPOC() - pRPL0->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i) * (pocMask + 1) - (getPOC() & pocMask);
1360 }
1361 pcRefPic = xGetLongTermRefPic(rcListPic, ltrpPoc, pRPL0->getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(i), m_pcPic->layerId);
1362 refPicPOC = pcRefPic->getPOC();
1363 }
1364
1365 if (pcRefPic) // the checks are for all reference picture, but we may not have an inactive reference picture, if starting with a CRA
1366 {
1367 refPicDecodingOrderNumber = pcRefPic->getDecodingOrderNumber();
1368
1369 if (nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_CRA || nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_W_RADL || nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_N_LP)
1370 {
1371 CHECK(refPicPOC < prevIRAPSubpicPOC || refPicDecodingOrderNumber < prevIRAPSubpicDecOrderNo, "When the current subpicture, with nuh_layer_id equal to a particular value "
1372 "layerId and subpicture index equal to a particular value subpicIdx, is an IRAP subpicture, there shall be no picture referred to by an entry in RefPicList[0] that "
1373 "precedes, in output order or decoding order,any preceding picture, in decoding order (when present), containing an IRAP subpicture with nuh_layer_id equal to "
1374 "layerId and subpicture index equal to subpicIdx");
1375 }
1376
1377 if (prevIRAPSubpicPOC < getPOC() && !getSPS()->getFieldSeqFlag())
1378 {
1379 CHECK(refPicPOC < prevIRAPSubpicPOC || refPicDecodingOrderNumber < prevIRAPSubpicDecOrderNo, "When the current subpicture follows an IRAP subpicture having the same value "
1380 "of nuh_layer_id and the same value of subpicture index in both decoding and output order, there shall be no picture referred to by an active entry in RefPicList[ 0 ] "
1381 "that precedes the picture containing that IRAP subpicture in output order or decoding order");
1382 }
1383
1384 if (i < numActiveEntriesL0)
1385 {
1386 if (prevIRAPSubpicPOC < getPOC())
1387 {
1388 CHECK(refPicPOC < prevIRAPSubpicPOC || refPicDecodingOrderNumber < prevIRAPSubpicDecOrderNo, "When the current subpicture follows an IRAP subpicture having the same value "
1389 "of nuh_layer_id and the same value of subpicture index and the leading subpictures, if any, associated with that IRAP subpicture in both decoding and output order, "
1390 "there shall be no picture referred to by an entry in RefPicList[ 0 ] that precedes the picture containing that IRAP subpicture in output order or decoding order");
1391 }
1392
1393 if (nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RADL)
1394 {
1395 CHECK(refPicDecodingOrderNumber < prevIRAPSubpicDecOrderNo, "When the current subpicture, with nuh_layer_id equal to a particular value layerId and subpicture index equal "
1396 "to a particular value subpicIdx, is a RADL subpicture, there shall be no active entry in RefPicList[ 0 ] that is a picture that precedes the picture containing the"
1397 "associated IRAP subpicture in decoding order");
1398
1399 if (pcRefPic->layerId == m_nuhLayerId)
1400 {
1401 for (int i = 0; i < pcRefPic->numSlices; i++)
1402 {
1403 if (pcRefPic->sliceSubpicIdx[i] == curSubpicIdx)
1404 {
1405 CHECK(pcRefPic->slices[i]->getNalUnitType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RASL, "When the current subpicture, with nuh_layer_id equal to a particular value layerId and "
1406 "subpicture index equal to a particular value subpicIdx, is a RADL subpicture, there shall be no active entry in RefPicList[ 0 ] that is a picture with "
1407 "nuh_layer_id equal to layerId containing a RASL subpicture with subpicture index equal to subpicIdx");
1408 }
1409 }
1410 }
1411 }
1412 }
1413 }
1414 }
1415
1416 for (int i = 0; i < numEntriesL1; i++)
1417 {
1418 if (pRPL1->isInterLayerRefPic(i))
1419 {
1420 int refLayerId = m_pcPic->cs->vps->getLayerId(m_pcPic->cs->vps->getDirectRefLayerIdx(layerIdx, pRPL1->getInterLayerRefPicIdx(i)));
1421 pcRefPic = xGetRefPic(rcListPic, getPOC(), refLayerId);
1422 refPicPOC = pcRefPic->getPOC();
1423 }
1424 else if (!pRPL1->isRefPicLongterm(i))
1425 {
1426 refPicPOC = getPOC() + pRPL1->getRefPicIdentifier(i);
1427 pcRefPic = xGetRefPic(rcListPic, refPicPOC, m_pcPic->layerId);
1428 }
1429 else
1430 {
1431 int pocBits = getSPS()->getBitsForPOC();
1432 int pocMask = (1 << pocBits) - 1;
1433 int ltrpPoc = pRPL1->getRefPicIdentifier(i) & pocMask;
1434 if (pRPL1->getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(i))
1435 {
1436 ltrpPoc += getPOC() - pRPL1->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i) * (pocMask + 1) - (getPOC() & pocMask);
1437 }
1438 pcRefPic = xGetLongTermRefPic(rcListPic, ltrpPoc, pRPL1->getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(i), m_pcPic->layerId);
1439 refPicPOC = pcRefPic->getPOC();
1440 }
1441 if (pcRefPic) // the checks are for all reference picture, but we may not have an inactive reference picture, if starting with a CRA
1442 {
1443 refPicDecodingOrderNumber = pcRefPic->getDecodingOrderNumber();
1444
1445 if (nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_CRA || nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_W_RADL || nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_N_LP)
1446 {
1447 CHECK(refPicPOC < prevIRAPSubpicPOC || refPicDecodingOrderNumber < prevIRAPSubpicDecOrderNo, "When the current subpicture, with nuh_layer_id equal to a particular value"
1448 "layerId and subpicture index equal to a particular value subpicIdx, is an IRAP subpicture, there shall be no picture referred to by an entry in RefPicList[1] that"
1449 "precedes, in output order or decoding order,any preceding picture, in decoding order (when present), containing an IRAP subpicture with nuh_layer_id equal to "
1450 "layerId and subpicture index equal to subpicIdx");
1451 }
1452
1453 if (prevIRAPSubpicPOC < getPOC() && !getSPS()->getFieldSeqFlag())
1454 {
1455 CHECK(refPicPOC < prevIRAPSubpicPOC || refPicDecodingOrderNumber < prevIRAPSubpicDecOrderNo, "When the current subpicture follows an IRAP subpicture having the same value "
1456 "of nuh_layer_id and the same value of subpicture index in both decoding and output order, there shall be no picture referred to by an active entry in RefPicList[ 1 ] "
1457 "that precedes the picture containing that IRAP subpicture in output order or decoding order");
1458 }
1459 if (i < numActiveEntriesL1)
1460 {
1461 if (prevIRAPSubpicPOC < getPOC())
1462 {
1463 CHECK(refPicPOC < prevIRAPSubpicPOC || refPicDecodingOrderNumber < prevIRAPSubpicDecOrderNo, "When the current subpicture follows an IRAP subpicture having the same value "
1464 "of nuh_layer_id and the same value of subpicture index and the leading subpictures, if any, associated with that IRAP subpicture in both decoding and output order, "
1465 "there shall be no picture referred to by an entry in RefPicList[ 1 ] that precedes the picture containing that IRAP subpicture in output order or decoding order");
1466 }
1467
1468 if (nalUnitType == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RADL)
1469 {
1470 CHECK(refPicDecodingOrderNumber < prevIRAPSubpicDecOrderNo, "When the current subpicture, with nuh_layer_id equal to a particular value layerId and subpicture index equal "
1471 "to a particular value subpicIdx, is a RADL subpicture, there shall be no active entry in RefPicList[ 1 ] that is a picture that precedes the picture containing the"
1472 "associated IRAP subpicture in decoding order");
1473
1474 if (pcRefPic->layerId == m_nuhLayerId)
1475 {
1476 for (int i = 0; i < pcRefPic->numSlices; i++)
1477 {
1478 if (pcRefPic->sliceSubpicIdx[i] == curSubpicIdx)
1479 {
1480 CHECK(pcRefPic->slices[i]->getNalUnitType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_RASL, "When the current subpicture, with nuh_layer_id equal to a particular value layerId and "
1481 "subpicture index equal to a particular value subpicIdx, is a RADL subpicture, there shall be no active entry in RefPicList[ 1 ] that is a picture with "
1482 "nuh_layer_id equal to layerId containing a RASL subpicture with subpicture index equal to subpicIdx");
1483 }
1484 }
1485 }
1486 }
1487 }
1488 }
1489 }
1490}

1493//Function for applying picture marking based on the Reference Picture List
1494void Slice::applyReferencePictureListBasedMarking( PicList& rcListPic, const ReferencePictureList *pRPL0, const ReferencePictureList *pRPL1, const int layerId, const PPS& pps ) const
1495{
1496 int i, isReference;
1497 checkLeadingPictureRestrictions(rcListPic, pps);
1498
1499 bool isNeedToCheck = (this->getNalUnitType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_N_LP || this->getNalUnitType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_W_RADL) ? false : true;
1500
1501 // mark long-term reference pictures in List0
1502 for( i = 0; i < pRPL0->getNumberOfShorttermPictures() + pRPL0->getNumberOfLongtermPictures() + pRPL0->getNumberOfInterLayerPictures(); i++ )
1503 {
1504 if( !pRPL0->isRefPicLongterm( i ) || pRPL0->isInterLayerRefPic( i ) )
1505 {
1506 continue;
1507 }
1508
1509 int isAvailable = 0;
1510 PicList::iterator iterPic = rcListPic.begin();
1511 while (iterPic != rcListPic.end())
1512 {
1513 Picture* rpcPic = *(iterPic++);
1514 if (!rpcPic->referenced)
1515 {
1516 continue;
1517 }
1518 int pocCycle = 1 << (rpcPic->cs->sps->getBitsForPOC());
1519 int curPoc = rpcPic->getPOC();
1520 int refPoc = pRPL0->getRefPicIdentifier(i) & (pocCycle - 1);
1521 if(pRPL0->getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(i))
1522 {
1523 refPoc += getPOC() - pRPL0->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i) * pocCycle - (getPOC() & (pocCycle - 1));
1524 }
1525 else
1526 {
1527 curPoc = curPoc & (pocCycle - 1);
1528 }
1529 if (rpcPic->longTerm && curPoc == refPoc && rpcPic->referenced)
1530 {
1531 isAvailable = 1;
1532 break;
1533 }
1534 }
1535 // if there was no such long-term check the short terms
1536 if (!isAvailable)
1537 {
1538 iterPic = rcListPic.begin();
1539 while (iterPic != rcListPic.end())
1540 {
1541 Picture* rpcPic = *(iterPic++);
1542 if (!rpcPic->referenced)
1543 {
1544 continue;
1545 }
1546 int pocCycle = 1 << (rpcPic->cs->sps->getBitsForPOC());
1547 int curPoc = rpcPic->getPOC();
1548 int refPoc = pRPL0->getRefPicIdentifier(i) & (pocCycle - 1);
1549 if(pRPL0->getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(i))
1550 {
1551 refPoc += getPOC() - pRPL0->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i) * pocCycle - (getPOC() & (pocCycle - 1));
1552 }
1553 else
1554 {
1555 curPoc = curPoc & (pocCycle - 1);
1556 }
1557 if (!rpcPic->longTerm && curPoc == refPoc && rpcPic->referenced)
1558 {
1559 isAvailable = 1;
1560 rpcPic->longTerm = true;
1561 break;
1562 }
1563 }
1564 }
1565 }
1566
1567 // mark long-term reference pictures in List1
1568 for( i = 0; i < pRPL1->getNumberOfShorttermPictures() + pRPL1->getNumberOfLongtermPictures() + pRPL1->getNumberOfInterLayerPictures(); i++ )
1569 {
1570 if( !pRPL1->isRefPicLongterm( i ) || pRPL1->isInterLayerRefPic( i ) )
1571 {
1572 continue;
1573 }
1574
1575 int isAvailable = 0;
1576 PicList::iterator iterPic = rcListPic.begin();
1577 while (iterPic != rcListPic.end())
1578 {
1579 Picture* rpcPic = *(iterPic++);
1580 if (!rpcPic->referenced)
1581 {
1582 continue;
1583 }
1584 int pocCycle = 1 << (rpcPic->cs->sps->getBitsForPOC());
1585 int curPoc = rpcPic->getPOC();
1586 int refPoc = pRPL1->getRefPicIdentifier(i) & (pocCycle - 1);
1587 if(pRPL1->getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(i))
1588 {
1589 refPoc += getPOC() - pRPL1->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i) * pocCycle - (getPOC() & (pocCycle - 1));
1590 }
1591 else
1592 {
1593 curPoc = curPoc & (pocCycle - 1);
1594 }
1595 if (rpcPic->longTerm && curPoc == refPoc && rpcPic->referenced)
1596 {
1597 isAvailable = 1;
1598 break;
1599 }
1600 }
1601 // if there was no such long-term check the short terms
1602 if (!isAvailable)
1603 {
1604 iterPic = rcListPic.begin();
1605 while (iterPic != rcListPic.end())
1606 {
1607 Picture* rpcPic = *(iterPic++);
1608 if (!rpcPic->referenced)
1609 {
1610 continue;
1611 }
1612 int pocCycle = 1 << (rpcPic->cs->sps->getBitsForPOC());
1613 int curPoc = rpcPic->getPOC();
1614 int refPoc = pRPL1->getRefPicIdentifier(i) & (pocCycle - 1);
1615 if(pRPL1->getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(i))
1616 {
1617 refPoc += getPOC() - pRPL1->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i) * pocCycle - (getPOC() & (pocCycle - 1));
1618 }
1619 else
1620 {
1621 curPoc = curPoc & (pocCycle - 1);
1622 }
1623 if (!rpcPic->longTerm && curPoc == refPoc && rpcPic->referenced)
1624 {
1625 isAvailable = 1;
1626 rpcPic->longTerm = true;
1627 break;
1628 }
1629 }
1630 }
1631 }
1632
1633 // loop through all pictures in the reference picture buffer
1634 PicList::iterator iterPic = rcListPic.begin();
1635 while (iterPic != rcListPic.end())
1636 {
1637 Picture* pcPic = *(iterPic++);
1638
1639 if (!pcPic->referenced)
1640 continue;
1641
1642 isReference = 0;
1643 // loop through all pictures in the Reference Picture Set
1644 // to see if the picture should be kept as reference picture
1645 for( i = 0; isNeedToCheck && !isReference && i < pRPL0->getNumberOfShorttermPictures() + pRPL0->getNumberOfLongtermPictures() + pRPL0->getNumberOfInterLayerPictures(); i++ )
1646 {
1647 if( pRPL0->isInterLayerRefPic( i ) )
1648 {
1649 // Diagonal inter-layer prediction is not allowed
1650 CHECK( pRPL0->getRefPicIdentifier( i ), "ILRP identifier should be 0" );
1651
1652 if( pcPic->poc == m_iPOC )
1653 {
1654 isReference = 1;
1655 pcPic->longTerm = true;
1656 }
1657 }
1658 else if (pcPic->layerId == layerId)
1659 {
1660 if (!(pRPL0->isRefPicLongterm(i)))
1661 {
1662 if (pcPic->poc == this->getPOC() + pRPL0->getRefPicIdentifier(i))
1663 {
1664 isReference = 1;
1665 pcPic->longTerm = false;
1666 }
1667 }
1668 else
1669 {
1670 int pocCycle = 1 << (pcPic->cs->sps->getBitsForPOC());
1671 int curPoc = pcPic->poc;
1672 int refPoc = pRPL0->getRefPicIdentifier(i) & (pocCycle - 1);
1673 if(pRPL0->getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(i))
1674 {
1675 refPoc += getPOC() - pRPL0->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i) * pocCycle - (getPOC() & (pocCycle - 1));
1676 }
1677 else
1678 {
1679 curPoc = curPoc & (pocCycle - 1);
1680 }
1681 if (pcPic->longTerm && curPoc == refPoc)
1682 {
1683 isReference = 1;
1684 pcPic->longTerm = true;
1685 }
1686 }
1687 }
1688 }
1689
1690 for( i = 0; isNeedToCheck && !isReference && i < pRPL1->getNumberOfShorttermPictures() + pRPL1->getNumberOfLongtermPictures() + pRPL1->getNumberOfInterLayerPictures(); i++ )
1691 {
1692 if( pRPL1->isInterLayerRefPic( i ) )
1693 {
1694 // Diagonal inter-layer prediction is not allowed
1695 CHECK( pRPL1->getRefPicIdentifier( i ), "ILRP identifier should be 0" );
1696
1697 if( pcPic->poc == m_iPOC )
1698 {
1699 isReference = 1;
1700 pcPic->longTerm = true;
1701 }
1702 }
1703 else if( pcPic->layerId == layerId )
1704 {
1705 if (!(pRPL1->isRefPicLongterm(i)))
1706 {
1707 if (pcPic->poc == this->getPOC() + pRPL1->getRefPicIdentifier(i))
1708 {
1709 isReference = 1;
1710 pcPic->longTerm = false;
1711 }
1712 }
1713 else
1714 {
1715 int pocCycle = 1 << (pcPic->cs->sps->getBitsForPOC());
1716 int curPoc = pcPic->poc;
1717 int refPoc = pRPL1->getRefPicIdentifier(i) & (pocCycle - 1);
1718 if(pRPL1->getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(i))
1719 {
1720 refPoc += getPOC() - pRPL1->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i) * pocCycle - (getPOC() & (pocCycle - 1));
1721 }
1722 else
1723 {
1724 curPoc = curPoc & (pocCycle - 1);
1725 }
1726 if (pcPic->longTerm && curPoc == refPoc)
1727 {
1728 isReference = 1;
1729 pcPic->longTerm = true;
1730 }
1731 }
1732 }
1733 }
1734 // mark the picture as "unused for reference" if it is not in
1735 // the Reference Picture List
1736 if( pcPic->layerId == layerId && pcPic->poc != m_iPOC && isReference == 0 )
1737 {
1738 pcPic->referenced = false;
1739 pcPic->longTerm = false;
1740 }
1741
1742 // sanity checks
1743 if (pcPic->referenced)
1744 {
1745 //check that pictures of higher temporal layers are not used
1746 CHECK(pcPic->usedByCurr && !(pcPic->temporalId <= this->getTLayer()), "Invalid state");
1747 }
1748 }
1749}

1751int Slice::checkThatAllRefPicsAreAvailable(PicList& rcListPic, const ReferencePictureList *pRPL, int rplIdx, bool printErrors) const
1752{
1753 Picture* rpcPic;
1754 int isAvailable = 0;
1755 int notPresentPoc = 0;
1756
1757 if (this->isIDRorBLA()) return 0; //Assume that all pic in the DPB will be flushed anyway so no need to check.
1758
1759 int numberOfPictures = pRPL->getNumberOfLongtermPictures() + pRPL->getNumberOfShorttermPictures() + pRPL->getNumberOfInterLayerPictures();
1760 //Check long term ref pics
1761 for (int ii = 0; pRPL->getNumberOfLongtermPictures() > 0 && ii < numberOfPictures; ii++)
1762 {
1763 if( !pRPL->isRefPicLongterm( ii ) || pRPL->isInterLayerRefPic( ii ) )
1764 {
1765 continue;
1766 }
1767
1768 notPresentPoc = pRPL->getRefPicIdentifier(ii);
1769 isAvailable = 0;
1770 PicList::iterator iterPic = rcListPic.begin();
1771 while (iterPic != rcListPic.end())
1772 {
1773 rpcPic = *(iterPic++);
1774 int pocCycle = 1 << (rpcPic->cs->sps->getBitsForPOC());
1775 int curPoc = rpcPic->getPOC();
1776 int refPoc = pRPL->getRefPicIdentifier(ii) & (pocCycle - 1);
1777 if(pRPL->getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(ii))
1778 {
1779 refPoc += getPOC() - pRPL->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(ii) * pocCycle - (getPOC() & (pocCycle - 1));
1780 }
1781 else
1782 {
1783 curPoc = curPoc & (pocCycle - 1);
1784 }
1785 if (rpcPic->longTerm && curPoc == refPoc && rpcPic->referenced)
1786 {
1787 isAvailable = 1;
1788 break;
1789 }
1790 }
1791 // if there was no such long-term check the short terms
1792 if (!isAvailable)
1793 {
1794 iterPic = rcListPic.begin();
1795 while (iterPic != rcListPic.end())
1796 {
1797 rpcPic = *(iterPic++);
1798 int pocCycle = 1 << (rpcPic->cs->sps->getBitsForPOC());
1799 int curPoc = rpcPic->getPOC();
1800 int refPoc = pRPL->getRefPicIdentifier(ii) & (pocCycle - 1);
1801 if(pRPL->getDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(ii))
1802 {
1803 refPoc += getPOC() - pRPL->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(ii) * pocCycle - (getPOC() & (pocCycle - 1));
1804 }
1805 else
1806 {
1807 curPoc = curPoc & (pocCycle - 1);
1808 }
1809 if (!rpcPic->longTerm && curPoc == refPoc && rpcPic->referenced)
1810 {
1811 isAvailable = 1;
1812 rpcPic->longTerm = true;
1813 break;
1814 }
1815 }
1816 }
1817 if (!isAvailable)
1818 {
1819 if (printErrors)
1820 {
1821 msg(ERROR, "\nCurrent picture: %d Long-term reference picture with POC = %3d seems to have been removed or not correctly decoded.", this->getPOC(), notPresentPoc);
1822 }
1823 return notPresentPoc;
1824 }
1825 }
1826 //report that a picture is lost if it is in the Reference Picture List but not in the DPB
1827
1828 isAvailable = 0;
1829 //Check short term ref pics
1830 for (int ii = 0; ii < numberOfPictures; ii++)
1831 {
1832 if (pRPL->isRefPicLongterm(ii))
1833 continue;
1834
1835 notPresentPoc = this->getPOC() + pRPL->getRefPicIdentifier(ii);
1836 isAvailable = 0;
1837 PicList::iterator iterPic = rcListPic.begin();
1838 while (iterPic != rcListPic.end())
1839 {
1840 rpcPic = *(iterPic++);
1841 if (!rpcPic->longTerm && rpcPic->getPOC() == this->getPOC() + pRPL->getRefPicIdentifier(ii) && rpcPic->referenced)
1842 {
1843 isAvailable = 1;
1844 break;
1845 }
1846 }
1847 //report that a picture is lost if it is in the Reference Picture List but not in the DPB
1848 if (isAvailable == 0 && pRPL->getNumberOfShorttermPictures() > 0)
1849 {
1850 if (printErrors)
1851 {
1852 msg(ERROR, "\nCurrent picture: %d Short-term reference picture with POC = %3d seems to have been removed or not correctly decoded.", this->getPOC(), notPresentPoc);
1853 }
1854 return notPresentPoc;
1855 }
1856 }
1857 return 0;
1858}

1972bool Slice::isPOCInRefPicList(const ReferencePictureList *rpl, int poc )
1973{
1974 for( int i = 0; i < rpl->getNumberOfLongtermPictures() + rpl->getNumberOfShorttermPictures() + rpl->getNumberOfInterLayerPictures(); i++ )
1975 {
1976 if( rpl->isInterLayerRefPic( i ) )
1977 {
1978 // Diagonal inter-layer prediction is not allowed
1979 CHECK( rpl->getRefPicIdentifier( i ), "ILRP identifier should be 0" );
1980
1981 if( poc == m_iPOC )
1982 {
1983 return true;
1984 }
1985 }
1986 else
1987 if (rpl->isRefPicLongterm(i))
1988 {
1989 if (poc == rpl->getRefPicIdentifier(i))
1990 {
1991 return true;
1992 }
1993 }
1994 else
1995 {
1996 if (poc == getPOC() + rpl->getRefPicIdentifier(i))
1997 {
1998 return true;
1999 }
2000 }
2001 }
2002 return false;
2003}
2004
2005bool Slice::isPocRestrictedByDRAP( int poc, bool precedingDRAPInDecodingOrder )
2006{
2007 if (!getEnableDRAPSEI())
2008 {
2009 return false;
2010 }
2011 return ( isDRAP() && poc != getAssociatedIRAPPOC() ) ||
2012 ( cvsHasPreviousDRAP() && getPOC() > getLatestDRAPPOC() && (precedingDRAPInDecodingOrder || poc < getLatestDRAPPOC()) );
2013}
2014
2015void Slice::checkConformanceForDRAP( uint32_t temporalId )
2016{
2017 if (!(isDRAP() || cvsHasPreviousDRAP()))
2018 {
2019 return;
2020 }
2021
2022 if (isDRAP())
2023 {
2024 if (!(getNalUnitType() == NalUnitType::NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_TRAIL ||
2025 getNalUnitType() == NalUnitType::NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_STSA))
2026 {
2027 msg( WARNING, "Warning, non-conforming bitstream. The DRAP picture should be a trailing picture.\n");
2028 }
2029 if ( temporalId != 0)
2030 {
2031 msg( WARNING, "Warning, non-conforming bitstream. The DRAP picture shall have a temporal sublayer identifier equal to 0.\n");
2032 }
2033 for (int i = 0; i < getNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_0); i++)
2034 {
2035 if (getRefPic(REF_PIC_LIST_0,i)->getPOC() != getAssociatedIRAPPOC())
2036 {
2037 msg( WARNING, "Warning, non-conforming bitstream. The DRAP picture shall not include any pictures in the active "
2038 "entries of its reference picture lists except the preceding IRAP picture in decoding order.\n");
2039 }
2040 }
2041 for (int i = 0; i < getNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_1); i++)
2042 {
2043 if (getRefPic(REF_PIC_LIST_1,i)->getPOC() != getAssociatedIRAPPOC())
2044 {
2045 msg( WARNING, "Warning, non-conforming bitstream. The DRAP picture shall not include any pictures in the active "
2046 "entries of its reference picture lists except the preceding IRAP picture in decoding order.\n");
2047 }
2048 }
2049 }
2050
2051 if (cvsHasPreviousDRAP() && getPOC() > getLatestDRAPPOC())
2052 {
2053 for (int i = 0; i < getNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_0); i++)
2054 {
2055 if (getRefPic(REF_PIC_LIST_0,i)->getPOC() < getLatestDRAPPOC() && getRefPic(REF_PIC_LIST_0,i)->getPOC() != getAssociatedIRAPPOC())
2056 {
2057 msg( WARNING, "Warning, non-conforming bitstream. Any picture that follows the DRAP picture in both decoding order "
2058 "and output order shall not include, in the active entries of its reference picture lists, any picture "
2059 "that precedes the DRAP picture in decoding order or output order, with the exception of the preceding "
2060 "IRAP picture in decoding order. Problem is POC %d in RPL0.\n", getRefPic(REF_PIC_LIST_0,i)->getPOC());
2061 }
2062 }
2063 for (int i = 0; i < getNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_1); i++)
2064 {
2065 if (getRefPic(REF_PIC_LIST_1,i)->getPOC() < getLatestDRAPPOC() && getRefPic(REF_PIC_LIST_1,i)->getPOC() != getAssociatedIRAPPOC())
2066 {
2067 msg( WARNING, "Warning, non-conforming bitstream. Any picture that follows the DRAP picture in both decoding order "
2068 "and output order shall not include, in the active entries of its reference picture lists, any picture "
2069 "that precedes the DRAP picture in decoding order or output order, with the exception of the preceding "
2070 "IRAP picture in decoding order. Problem is POC %d in RPL1", getRefPic(REF_PIC_LIST_1,i)->getPOC());
2071 }
2072 }
2073 }
2074}

2094const WPScalingParam *Slice::getWpScaling(const RefPicList refPicList, const int refIdx) const
2095{
2096 CHECK(refPicList >= NUM_REF_PIC_LIST_01, "Invalid picture reference list");
2097 if (refIdx < 0)
2098 {
2099 return nullptr;
2100 }
2101 else
2102 {
2103 return m_weightPredTable[refPicList][refIdx];
2104 }
2105}

2121void Slice::resetWpScaling()
2122{
2123 for ( int e=0 ; e<NUM_REF_PIC_LIST_01 ; e++ )
2124 {
2125 for ( int i=0 ; i<MAX_NUM_REF ; i++ )
2126 {
2127 for ( int yuv=0 ; yuv<MAX_NUM_COMPONENT ; yuv++ )
2128 {
2129 WPScalingParam *pwp = &(m_weightPredTable[e][i][yuv]);
2130 pwp->presentFlag = false;
2131 pwp->log2WeightDenom = 0;
2132 pwp->log2WeightDenom = 0;
2133 pwp->codedWeight = 1;
2134 pwp->codedOffset = 0;
2135 }
2136 }
2137 }
2138}
2139
2141void Slice::initWpScaling(const SPS *sps)
2142{
2143 const bool bUseHighPrecisionPredictionWeighting = sps->getSpsRangeExtension().getHighPrecisionOffsetsEnabledFlag();
2144 for ( int e=0 ; e<NUM_REF_PIC_LIST_01 ; e++ )
2145 {
2146 for ( int i=0 ; i<MAX_NUM_REF ; i++ )
2147 {
2148 for ( int yuv=0 ; yuv<MAX_NUM_COMPONENT ; yuv++ )
2149 {
2150 WPScalingParam *pwp = &(m_weightPredTable[e][i][yuv]);
2151 if (!pwp->presentFlag)
2152 {
2153 // Inferring values not present :
2154 pwp->codedWeight = (1 << pwp->log2WeightDenom);
2155 pwp->codedOffset = 0;
2156 }
2157
2158 const int offsetScalingFactor = bUseHighPrecisionPredictionWeighting ? 1 : (1 << (sps->getBitDepth(toChannelType(ComponentID(yuv)))-8));
2159
2160 pwp->w = pwp->codedWeight;
2161 pwp->o = pwp->codedOffset * offsetScalingFactor; // NOTE: This value of the ".o" variable is never used - .o
2162 // is set immediately before it gets used
2163 pwp->shift = pwp->log2WeightDenom;
2164 pwp->round = (pwp->log2WeightDenom >= 1) ? (1 << (pwp->log2WeightDenom - 1)) : (0);
2165 }
2166 }
2167 }
2168}

2182unsigned Slice::getMinPictureDistance() const
2183{
2184 int minPicDist = MAX_INT;
2185 if (getSPS()->getIBCFlag())
2186 {
2187 minPicDist = 0;
2188 }
2189 else
2190 if( ! isIntra() )
2191 {
2192 const int currPOC = getPOC();
2193 for (int refIdx = 0; refIdx < getNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_0); refIdx++)
2194 {
2195 minPicDist = std::min( minPicDist, std::abs(currPOC - getRefPic(REF_PIC_LIST_0, refIdx)->getPOC()));
2196 }
2197 if( getSliceType() == B_SLICE )
2198 {
2199 for (int refIdx = 0; refIdx < getNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_1); refIdx++)
2200 {
2201 minPicDist = std::min(minPicDist, std::abs(currPOC - getRefPic(REF_PIC_LIST_1, refIdx)->getPOC()));
2202 }
2203 }
2204 }
2205 return (unsigned) minPicDist;
2206}

2275void VPS::deriveOutputLayerSets()
2276{
2277 if( m_vpsEachLayerIsAnOlsFlag || m_vpsOlsModeIdc < 2 )
2278 {
2279 m_totalNumOLSs = m_maxLayers;
2280 }
2281 else if( m_vpsOlsModeIdc == 2 )
2282 {
2283 m_totalNumOLSs = m_vpsNumOutputLayerSets;
2284 }
2285
2286 m_olsDpbParamsIdx.resize( m_totalNumOLSs );
2287 m_olsDpbPicSize.resize( m_totalNumOLSs, Size(0, 0) );
2288 m_numOutputLayersInOls.resize( m_totalNumOLSs );
2289 m_numLayersInOls.resize( m_totalNumOLSs );
2290 m_outputLayerIdInOls.resize( m_totalNumOLSs, std::vector<int>( m_maxLayers, NOT_VALID ) );
2291 m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS.resize( m_totalNumOLSs, std::vector<int>( m_maxLayers, NOT_VALID ) );
2292 m_layerIdInOls.resize( m_totalNumOLSs, std::vector<int>( m_maxLayers, NOT_VALID ) );
2293 m_olsDpbChromaFormatIdc.resize(m_totalNumOLSs);
2294 m_olsDpbBitDepthMinus8.resize(m_totalNumOLSs);
2295
2296 std::vector<int> numRefLayers( m_maxLayers );
2297 std::vector<std::vector<int>> outputLayerIdx( m_totalNumOLSs, std::vector<int>( m_maxLayers, NOT_VALID ) );
2298 std::vector<std::vector<int>> layerIncludedInOlsFlag( m_totalNumOLSs, std::vector<int>( m_maxLayers, 0 ) );
2299 std::vector<std::vector<int>> dependencyFlag( m_maxLayers, std::vector<int>( m_maxLayers, NOT_VALID ) );
2300 std::vector<std::vector<int>> refLayerIdx( m_maxLayers, std::vector<int>( m_maxLayers, NOT_VALID ) );
2301 std::vector<int> layerUsedAsRefLayerFlag( m_maxLayers, 0 );
2302 std::vector<int> layerUsedAsOutputLayerFlag( m_maxLayers, NOT_VALID );
2303
2304 for( int i = 0; i < m_maxLayers; i++ )
2305 {
2306 int r = 0;
2307
2308 for( int j = 0; j < m_maxLayers; j++ )
2309 {
2310 dependencyFlag[i][j] = m_vpsDirectRefLayerFlag[i][j];
2311
2312 for( int k = 0; k < i; k++ )
2313 {
2314 if( m_vpsDirectRefLayerFlag[i][k] && dependencyFlag[k][j] )
2315 {
2316 dependencyFlag[i][j] = 1;
2317 }
2318 }
2319 if (m_vpsDirectRefLayerFlag[i][j])
2320 {
2321 layerUsedAsRefLayerFlag[j] = 1;
2322 }
2323
2324 if( dependencyFlag[i][j] )
2325 {
2326 refLayerIdx[i][r++] = j;
2327 }
2328 }
2329
2330 numRefLayers[i] = r;
2331 }
2332
2333 m_numOutputLayersInOls[0] = 1;
2334 m_outputLayerIdInOls[0][0] = m_vpsLayerId[0];
2335#if JVET_R0193_S0141
2336 m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[0][0] = m_ptlMaxTemporalId[m_olsPtlIdx[0]] + 1;
2337#else
2338 m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[0][0] = m_vpsMaxSubLayers;
2339#endif
2340 layerUsedAsOutputLayerFlag[0] = 1;
2341 for (int i = 1; i < m_maxLayers; i++)
2342 {
2343 if (m_vpsEachLayerIsAnOlsFlag || m_vpsOlsModeIdc < 2)
2344 {
2345 layerUsedAsOutputLayerFlag[i] = 1;
2346 }
2347 else
2348 {
2349 layerUsedAsOutputLayerFlag[i] = 0;
2350 }
2351 }
2352 for( int i = 1; i < m_totalNumOLSs; i++ )
2353 {
2354 if( m_vpsEachLayerIsAnOlsFlag || m_vpsOlsModeIdc == 0 )
2355 {
2356 m_numOutputLayersInOls[i] = 1;
2357 m_outputLayerIdInOls[i][0] = m_vpsLayerId[i];
2358#if JVET_R0193_S0141
2359 if (m_vpsEachLayerIsAnOlsFlag)
2360 {
2361 m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[i][0] = m_ptlMaxTemporalId[m_olsPtlIdx[i]] + 1;
2362 }
2363 else
2364 {
2365 m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[i][i] = m_ptlMaxTemporalId[m_olsPtlIdx[i]] + 1;
2366 for (int k = i - 1; k >= 0; k--)
2367 {
2368 m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[i][k] = 0;
2369 for (int m = k + 1; m <= i; m++)
2370 {
2371 uint32_t maxSublayerNeeded = std::min((uint32_t)m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[i][m], m_vpsMaxTidIlRefPicsPlus1[m][k]);
2372 if (m_vpsDirectRefLayerFlag[m][k] && m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[i][k] < maxSublayerNeeded)
2373 {
2374 m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[i][k] = maxSublayerNeeded;
2375 }
2376 }
2377 }
2378 }
2379#else
2380 for(int j = 0; j < i && ( m_vpsOlsModeIdc == 0 ); j++ )
2381 {
2382 m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[i][j] = m_vpsMaxTidIlRefPicsPlus1[i];
2383 }
2384 m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[i][i] = m_vpsMaxSubLayers;
2385#endif
2386 }
2387 else if( m_vpsOlsModeIdc == 1 )
2388 {
2389 m_numOutputLayersInOls[i] = i + 1;
2390
2391 for( int j = 0; j < m_numOutputLayersInOls[i]; j++ )
2392 {
2393 m_outputLayerIdInOls[i][j] = m_vpsLayerId[j];
2394#if JVET_R0193_S0141
2395 m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[i][j] = m_ptlMaxTemporalId[m_olsPtlIdx[i]] + 1;
2396#else
2397 m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[i][j] = m_vpsMaxSubLayers;
2398#endif
2399 }
2400 }
2401 else if( m_vpsOlsModeIdc == 2 )
2402 {
2403 int j = 0;
2404#if JVET_R0193
2405 int highestIncludedLayer = 0;
2406#endif
2407 for( j = 0; j < m_maxLayers; j++ )
2408 {
2409 m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[i][j] = 0;
2410 }
2411 j = 0;
2412 for( int k = 0; k < m_maxLayers; k++ )
2413 {
2414 if( m_vpsOlsOutputLayerFlag[i][k] )
2415 {
2416 layerIncludedInOlsFlag[i][k] = 1;
2417#if JVET_R0193
2418 highestIncludedLayer = k;
2419#endif
2420 layerUsedAsOutputLayerFlag[k] = 1;
2421 outputLayerIdx[i][j] = k;
2422 m_outputLayerIdInOls[i][j++] = m_vpsLayerId[k];
2423#if JVET_R0193_S0141
2424 m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[i][k] = m_ptlMaxTemporalId[m_olsPtlIdx[i]] + 1;
2425#else
2426 m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[i][k] = m_vpsMaxSubLayers;
2427#endif
2428 }
2429 }
2430 m_numOutputLayersInOls[i] = j;
2431
2432 for( j = 0; j < m_numOutputLayersInOls[i]; j++ )
2433 {
2434 int idx = outputLayerIdx[i][j];
2435 for( int k = 0; k < numRefLayers[idx]; k++ )
2436 {
2437 layerIncludedInOlsFlag[i][refLayerIdx[idx][k]] = 1;
2438#if !JVET_R0193
2439 if( m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[i][ refLayerIdx[idx][k] ] < m_vpsMaxTidIlRefPicsPlus1[ m_outputLayerIdInOls[i][j] ] )
2440 {
2441 m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[i][ refLayerIdx[idx][k] ] = m_vpsMaxTidIlRefPicsPlus1[ m_outputLayerIdInOls[i][j] ];
2442 }
2443#endif
2444 }
2445 }
2446#if JVET_R0193
2447 for (int k = highestIncludedLayer - 1; k >= 0; k--)
2448 {
2449 if (layerIncludedInOlsFlag[i][k] && !m_vpsOlsOutputLayerFlag[i][k])
2450 {
2451 for (int m = k + 1; m <= highestIncludedLayer; m++)
2452 {
2453 uint32_t maxSublayerNeeded = std::min((uint32_t)m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[i][m], m_vpsMaxTidIlRefPicsPlus1[m][k]);
2454 if (m_vpsDirectRefLayerFlag[m][k] && layerIncludedInOlsFlag[i][m] && m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[i][k] < maxSublayerNeeded)
2455 {
2456 m_numSubLayersInLayerInOLS[i][k] = maxSublayerNeeded;
2457 }
2458 }
2459 }
2460 }
2461#endif
2462 }
2463 }
2464 for (int i = 0; i < m_maxLayers; i++)
2465 {
2466 CHECK(layerUsedAsRefLayerFlag[i] == 0 && layerUsedAsOutputLayerFlag[i] == 0, "There shall be no layer that is neither an output layer nor a direct reference layer");
2467 }
2468
2469 m_numLayersInOls[0] = 1;
2470 m_layerIdInOls[0][0] = m_vpsLayerId[0];
2471 m_numMultiLayeredOlss = 0;
2472 for( int i = 1; i < m_totalNumOLSs; i++ )
2473 {
2474 if( m_vpsEachLayerIsAnOlsFlag )
2475 {
2476 m_numLayersInOls[i] = 1;
2477 m_layerIdInOls[i][0] = m_vpsLayerId[i];
2478 }
2479 else if( m_vpsOlsModeIdc == 0 || m_vpsOlsModeIdc == 1 )
2480 {
2481 m_numLayersInOls[i] = i + 1;
2482 for( int j = 0; j < m_numLayersInOls[i]; j++ )
2483 {
2484 m_layerIdInOls[i][j] = m_vpsLayerId[j];
2485 }
2486 }
2487 else if( m_vpsOlsModeIdc == 2 )
2488 {
2489 int j = 0;
2490 for( int k = 0; k < m_maxLayers; k++ )
2491 {
2492 if( layerIncludedInOlsFlag[i][k] )
2493 {
2494 m_layerIdInOls[i][j++] = m_vpsLayerId[k];
2495 }
2496 }
2497
2498 m_numLayersInOls[i] = j;
2499 }
2500 if( m_numLayersInOls[i] > 1 )
2501 {
2502 m_multiLayerOlsIdx[i] = m_numMultiLayeredOlss;
2503 m_numMultiLayeredOlss++;
2504 }
2505 }
2506 m_multiLayerOlsIdxToOlsIdx.resize(m_numMultiLayeredOlss);
2507
2508 for (int i=0, j=0; i<m_totalNumOLSs; i++)
2509 {
2510 if (m_numLayersInOls[i] > 1)
2511 {
2512 m_multiLayerOlsIdxToOlsIdx[j] = i;
2513 }
2514 }
2515}
2516
2517void VPS::checkVPS()
2518{
2519 for (int multiLayerOlsIdx=0; multiLayerOlsIdx < m_numMultiLayeredOlss; multiLayerOlsIdx++)
2520 {
2521 const int olsIdx = m_multiLayerOlsIdxToOlsIdx[multiLayerOlsIdx];
2522 const int olsTimingHrdIdx = getOlsTimingHrdIdx(multiLayerOlsIdx);
2523 const int olsPtlIdx = getOlsPtlIdx(olsIdx);
2524 CHECK (getHrdMaxTid(olsTimingHrdIdx) < getPtlMaxTemporalId(olsPtlIdx), "The value of vps_hrd_max_tid[vps_ols_timing_hrd_idx[m]] shall be greater than or equal to "
2525 "vps_ptl_max_tid[ vps_ols_ptl_idx[n]] for each m-th multi-layer OLS for m from 0 to "
2526 "NumMultiLayerOlss - 1, inclusive, and n being the OLS index of the m-th multi-layer OLS among all OLSs.");
2527 const int olsDpbParamsIdx = getOlsDpbParamsIdx(multiLayerOlsIdx);
2528 CHECK (m_dpbMaxTemporalId[olsDpbParamsIdx] < getPtlMaxTemporalId(olsPtlIdx), "The value of vps_dpb_max_tid[vps_ols_dpb_params_idx[m]] shall be greater than or equal to "
2529 "vps_ptl_max_tid[ vps_ols_ptl_idx[n]] for each m-th multi-layer OLS for m from 0 to "
2530 "NumMultiLayerOlss - 1, inclusive, and n being the OLS index of the m-th multi-layer OLS among all OLSs.");
2531 }
2532}

2553int VPS::deriveTargetOLSIdx(void)

2595, m_noOutputBeforeRecoveryFlag ( false )

2598, m_spsId ( -1 )
2599, m_ppsId ( -1 )
2600, m_pocMsbPresentFlag ( 0 )
2601, m_pocMsbVal ( 0 )
2602, m_virtualBoundariesEnabledFlag ( 0 )

2964void ChromaQpMappingTable::setParams(const ChromaQpMappingTableParams &params, const int qpBdOffset)
2965{
2966 m_qpBdOffset = qpBdOffset;
2967 m_sameCQPTableForAllChromaFlag = params.m_sameCQPTableForAllChromaFlag;
2968 m_numQpTables = params.m_numQpTables;
2969
2970 for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NUM_CQP_MAPPING_TABLES; i++)
2971 {
2972 m_numPtsInCQPTableMinus1[i] = params.m_numPtsInCQPTableMinus1[i];
2973 m_deltaQpInValMinus1[i] = params.m_deltaQpInValMinus1[i];
2974 m_qpTableStartMinus26[i] = params.m_qpTableStartMinus26[i];
2975 m_deltaQpOutVal[i] = params.m_deltaQpOutVal[i];
2976 }
2977}
2978void ChromaQpMappingTable::derivedChromaQPMappingTables()
2979{
2980 for (int i = 0; i < getNumQpTables(); i++)
2981 {
2982 const int qpBdOffsetC = m_qpBdOffset;
2983 const int numPtsInCQPTableMinus1 = getNumPtsInCQPTableMinus1(i);
2984 std::vector<int> qpInVal(numPtsInCQPTableMinus1 + 2), qpOutVal(numPtsInCQPTableMinus1 + 2);
2985
2986 qpInVal[0] = getQpTableStartMinus26(i) + 26;
2987 qpOutVal[0] = qpInVal[0];
2988 for (int j = 0; j <= getNumPtsInCQPTableMinus1(i); j++)
2989 {
2990 qpInVal[j + 1] = qpInVal[j] + getDeltaQpInValMinus1(i, j) + 1;
2991 qpOutVal[j + 1] = qpOutVal[j] + getDeltaQpOutVal(i, j);
2992 }
2993
2994 for (int j = 0; j <= getNumPtsInCQPTableMinus1(i); j++)
2995 {
2996 CHECK(qpInVal[j] < -qpBdOffsetC || qpInVal[j] > MAX_QP, "qpInVal out of range");
2997 CHECK(qpOutVal[j] < -qpBdOffsetC || qpOutVal[j] > MAX_QP, "qpOutVal out of range");
2998 }
2999
3000 m_chromaQpMappingTables[i][qpInVal[0]] = qpOutVal[0];
3001 for (int k = qpInVal[0] - 1; k >= -qpBdOffsetC; k--)
3002 {
3003 m_chromaQpMappingTables[i][k] = Clip3(-qpBdOffsetC, MAX_QP, m_chromaQpMappingTables[i][k + 1] - 1);
3004 }
3005 for (int j = 0; j <= numPtsInCQPTableMinus1; j++)
3006 {
3007 int sh = (getDeltaQpInValMinus1(i, j) + 1) >> 1;
3008 for (int k = qpInVal[j] + 1, m = 1; k <= qpInVal[j + 1]; k++, m++)
3009 {
3010 m_chromaQpMappingTables[i][k] = m_chromaQpMappingTables[i][qpInVal[j]]
3011 + ((qpOutVal[j + 1] - qpOutVal[j]) * m + sh) / (getDeltaQpInValMinus1(i, j) + 1);
3012 }
3013 }
3014 for (int k = qpInVal[numPtsInCQPTableMinus1 + 1] + 1; k <= MAX_QP; k++)
3015 {
3016 m_chromaQpMappingTables[i][k] = Clip3(-qpBdOffsetC, MAX_QP, m_chromaQpMappingTables[i][k - 1] + 1);
3017 }
3018 }
3019}
