3173
3177void PPS::initTiles()
3178{
3179 int colIdx, rowIdx;
3180 int ctuX, ctuY;
3181
3182 // check explicit tile column sizes
3183 uint32_t remainingWidthInCtu = m_picWidthInCtu;
3184
3185 for( colIdx = 0; colIdx < m_numExpTileCols; colIdx++ )
3186 {
3187 CHECK(m_tileColWidth[colIdx] > remainingWidthInCtu, "Tile column width exceeds picture width");
3188 remainingWidthInCtu -= m_tileColWidth[colIdx];
3189 }
3190
3191 // divide remaining picture width into uniform tile columns
3192 uint32_t uniformTileColWidth = m_tileColWidth[colIdx-1];
3193 while( remainingWidthInCtu > 0 )
3194 {
3195 CHECK(colIdx >= MAX_TILE_COLS, "Number of tile columns exceeds valid range");
3196 uniformTileColWidth = std::min(remainingWidthInCtu, uniformTileColWidth);
3197 m_tileColWidth.push_back( uniformTileColWidth );
3198 remainingWidthInCtu -= uniformTileColWidth;
3199 colIdx++;
3200 }
3201 m_numTileCols = colIdx;
3202
3203 // check explicit tile row sizes
3204 uint32_t remainingHeightInCtu = m_picHeightInCtu;
3205
3206 for( rowIdx = 0; rowIdx < m_numExpTileRows; rowIdx++ )
3207 {
3208 CHECK(m_tileRowHeight[rowIdx] > remainingHeightInCtu, "Tile row height exceeds picture height");
3209 remainingHeightInCtu -= m_tileRowHeight[rowIdx];
3210 }
3211
3212 // divide remaining picture height into uniform tile rows
3213 uint32_t uniformTileRowHeight = m_tileRowHeight[rowIdx - 1];
3214 while( remainingHeightInCtu > 0 )
3215 {
3216 uniformTileRowHeight = std::min(remainingHeightInCtu, uniformTileRowHeight);
3217 m_tileRowHeight.push_back( uniformTileRowHeight );
3218 remainingHeightInCtu -= uniformTileRowHeight;
3219 rowIdx++;
3220 }
3221 m_numTileRows = rowIdx;
3222
3223 // set left column bounaries
3224 m_tileColBd.push_back( 0 );
3225 for( colIdx = 0; colIdx < m_numTileCols; colIdx++ )
3226 {
3227 m_tileColBd.push_back( m_tileColBd[ colIdx ] + m_tileColWidth[ colIdx ] );
3228 }
3229
3230 // set top row bounaries
3231 m_tileRowBd.push_back( 0 );
3232 for( rowIdx = 0; rowIdx < m_numTileRows; rowIdx++ )
3233 {
3234 m_tileRowBd.push_back( m_tileRowBd[ rowIdx ] + m_tileRowHeight[ rowIdx ] );
3235 }
3236
3237 // set mapping between horizontal CTU address and tile column index
3238 colIdx = 0;
3239 for( ctuX = 0; ctuX <= m_picWidthInCtu; ctuX++ )
3240 {
3241 if( ctuX == m_tileColBd[ colIdx + 1 ] )
3242 {
3243 colIdx++;
3244 }
3245 m_ctuToTileCol.push_back( colIdx );
3246 }
3247
3248 // set mapping between vertical CTU address and tile row index
3249 rowIdx = 0;
3250 for( ctuY = 0; ctuY <= m_picHeightInCtu; ctuY++ )
3251 {
3252 if( ctuY == m_tileRowBd[ rowIdx + 1 ] )
3253 {
3254 rowIdx++;
3255 }
3256 m_ctuToTileRow.push_back( rowIdx );
3257 }
3258}

3263void PPS::initRectSlices()
3264{
3265 CHECK(m_numSlicesInPic > MAX_SLICES, "Number of slices in picture exceeds valid range");
3266 m_rectSlices.resize(m_numSlicesInPic);
3267}
3268
3272void PPS::initRectSliceMap(const SPS *sps)
3273{
3274 uint32_t ctuY;
3275 uint32_t tileX, tileY;
3276
3277 if (sps)
3278 {
3279 m_ctuToSubPicIdx.resize(getPicWidthInCtu() * getPicHeightInCtu());
3280 if (sps->getNumSubPics() > 1)
3281 {
3282 for (int i = 0; i <= sps->getNumSubPics() - 1; i++)
3283 {
3284 for (int y = sps->getSubPicCtuTopLeftY(i); y < sps->getSubPicCtuTopLeftY(i) + sps->getSubPicHeight(i); y++)
3285 {
3286 for (int x = sps->getSubPicCtuTopLeftX(i); x < sps->getSubPicCtuTopLeftX(i) + sps->getSubPicWidth(i); x++)
3287 {
3288 m_ctuToSubPicIdx[ x+ y * getPicWidthInCtu()] = i;
3289 }
3290 }
3291 }
3292 }
3293 else
3294 {
3295 for (int i = 0; i < getPicWidthInCtu() * getPicHeightInCtu(); i++)
3296 {
3297 m_ctuToSubPicIdx[i] = 0;
3298 }
3299 }
3300 }
3301
3302 if( getSingleSlicePerSubPicFlag() )
3303 {
3304 CHECK (sps==nullptr, "RectSliceMap can only be initialized for slice_per_sub_pic_flag with a valid SPS");
3305 m_numSlicesInPic = sps->getNumSubPics();
3306
3307 // allocate new memory for slice list
3308 CHECK(m_numSlicesInPic > MAX_SLICES, "Number of slices in picture exceeds valid range");
3309 m_sliceMap.resize( m_numSlicesInPic );
3310
3311 if (sps->getNumSubPics() > 1)
3312 {
3313 // Q2001 v15 equation 29
3314 std::vector<uint32_t> subpicWidthInTiles;
3315 std::vector<uint32_t> subpicHeightInTiles;
3316 std::vector<uint32_t> subpicHeightLessThanOneTileFlag;
3317 subpicWidthInTiles.resize(sps->getNumSubPics());
3318 subpicHeightInTiles.resize(sps->getNumSubPics());
3319 subpicHeightLessThanOneTileFlag.resize(sps->getNumSubPics());
3320 for (uint32_t i = 0; i <sps->getNumSubPics(); i++)
3321 {
3322 uint32_t leftX = sps->getSubPicCtuTopLeftX(i);
3323 uint32_t rightX = leftX + sps->getSubPicWidth(i) - 1;
3324 subpicWidthInTiles[i] = m_ctuToTileCol[rightX] + 1 - m_ctuToTileCol[leftX];
3325
3326 uint32_t topY = sps->getSubPicCtuTopLeftY(i);
3327 uint32_t bottomY = topY + sps->getSubPicHeight(i) - 1;
3328 subpicHeightInTiles[i] = m_ctuToTileRow[bottomY] + 1 - m_ctuToTileRow[topY];
3329
3330 if (subpicHeightInTiles[i] == 1 && sps->getSubPicHeight(i) < m_tileRowHeight[m_ctuToTileRow[topY]] )
3331 {
3332 subpicHeightLessThanOneTileFlag[i] = 1;
3333 }
3334 else
3335 {
3336 subpicHeightLessThanOneTileFlag[i] = 0;
3337 }
3338 }
3339
3340 for( int i = 0; i < m_numSlicesInPic; i++ )
3341 {
3342 CHECK(m_numSlicesInPic != sps->getNumSubPics(), "in single slice per subpic mode, number of slice and subpic shall be equal");
3343 m_sliceMap[ i ].initSliceMap();
3344 if (subpicHeightLessThanOneTileFlag[i])
3345 {
3346 m_sliceMap[i].addCtusToSlice(sps->getSubPicCtuTopLeftX(i), sps->getSubPicCtuTopLeftX(i) + sps->getSubPicWidth(i),
3347 sps->getSubPicCtuTopLeftY(i), sps->getSubPicCtuTopLeftY(i) + sps->getSubPicHeight(i), m_picWidthInCtu);
3348 }
3349 else
3350 {
3351 tileX = m_ctuToTileCol[sps->getSubPicCtuTopLeftX(i)];
3352 tileY = m_ctuToTileRow[sps->getSubPicCtuTopLeftY(i)];
3353 for (uint32_t j = 0; j< subpicHeightInTiles[i]; j++)
3354 {
3355 for (uint32_t k = 0; k < subpicWidthInTiles[i]; k++)
3356 {
3357 m_sliceMap[i].addCtusToSlice(getTileColumnBd(tileX + k), getTileColumnBd(tileX + k + 1), getTileRowBd(tileY + j), getTileRowBd(tileY + j + 1), m_picWidthInCtu);
3358 }
3359 }
3360 }
3361 }
3362 subpicWidthInTiles.clear();
3363 subpicHeightInTiles.clear();
3364 subpicHeightLessThanOneTileFlag.clear();
3365 }
3366 else
3367 {
3368 m_sliceMap[0].initSliceMap();
3369 for (int tileY=0; tileY<m_numTileRows; tileY++)
3370 {
3371 for (int tileX=0; tileX<m_numTileCols; tileX++)
3372 {
3373 m_sliceMap[0].addCtusToSlice(getTileColumnBd(tileX), getTileColumnBd(tileX + 1),
3374 getTileRowBd(tileY), getTileRowBd(tileY + 1), m_picWidthInCtu);
3375 }
3376 }
3377 m_sliceMap[0].setSliceID(0);
3378 }
3379 }
3380 else
3381 {
3382 // allocate new memory for slice list
3383 CHECK(m_numSlicesInPic > MAX_SLICES, "Number of slices in picture exceeds valid range");
3384 m_sliceMap.resize( m_numSlicesInPic );
3385 // generate CTU maps for all rectangular slices in picture
3386 for( uint32_t i = 0; i < m_numSlicesInPic; i++ )
3387 {
3388 m_sliceMap[ i ].initSliceMap();
3389
3390 // get position of first tile in slice
3391 tileX = m_rectSlices[ i ].getTileIdx() % m_numTileCols;
3392 tileY = m_rectSlices[ i ].getTileIdx() / m_numTileCols;
3393
3394 // infer slice size for last slice in picture
3395 if( i == m_numSlicesInPic-1 )
3396 {
3397 m_rectSlices[ i ].setSliceWidthInTiles ( m_numTileCols - tileX );
3398 m_rectSlices[ i ].setSliceHeightInTiles( m_numTileRows - tileY );
3399 m_rectSlices[ i ].setNumSlicesInTile( 1 );
3400 }
3401
3402 // set slice index
3403 m_sliceMap[ i ].setSliceID(i);
3404
3405 // complete tiles within a single slice case
3406 if( m_rectSlices[ i ].getSliceWidthInTiles( ) > 1 || m_rectSlices[ i ].getSliceHeightInTiles( ) > 1)
3407 {
3408 for( uint32_t j = 0; j < m_rectSlices[ i ].getSliceHeightInTiles( ); j++ )
3409 {
3410 for( uint32_t k = 0; k < m_rectSlices[ i ].getSliceWidthInTiles( ); k++ )
3411 {
3412 m_sliceMap[ i ].addCtusToSlice( getTileColumnBd(tileX + k), getTileColumnBd(tileX + k +1),
3413 getTileRowBd(tileY + j), getTileRowBd(tileY + j +1), m_picWidthInCtu);
3414 }
3415 }
3416 }
3417 // multiple slices within a single tile case
3418 else
3419 {
3420 uint32_t numSlicesInTile = m_rectSlices[ i ].getNumSlicesInTile( );
3421
3422 ctuY = getTileRowBd( tileY );
3423 for( uint32_t j = 0; j < numSlicesInTile-1; j++ )
3424 {
3425 m_sliceMap[ i ].addCtusToSlice( getTileColumnBd(tileX), getTileColumnBd(tileX+1),
3426 ctuY, ctuY + m_rectSlices[ i ].getSliceHeightInCtu(), m_picWidthInCtu);
3427 ctuY += m_rectSlices[ i ].getSliceHeightInCtu();
3428 i++;
3429 m_sliceMap[ i ].initSliceMap();
3430 m_sliceMap[ i ].setSliceID(i);
3431 }
3432
3433 // infer slice height for last slice in tile
3434 CHECK( ctuY >= getTileRowBd( tileY + 1 ), "Invalid rectangular slice signalling");
3435 m_rectSlices[ i ].setSliceHeightInCtu( getTileRowBd( tileY + 1 ) - ctuY );
3436 m_sliceMap[ i ].addCtusToSlice( getTileColumnBd(tileX), getTileColumnBd(tileX+1),
3437 ctuY, getTileRowBd( tileY + 1 ), m_picWidthInCtu);
3438 }
3439 }
3440 }
3441 // check for valid rectangular slice map
3442 checkSliceMap();
3443}
3444
3448void PPS::initSubPic(const SPS &sps)
3449{
3450 if (getSubPicIdMappingInPpsFlag())
3451 {
3452 // When signalled, the number of subpictures has to match in PPS and SPS
3453 CHECK (getNumSubPics() != sps.getNumSubPics(), "pps_num_subpics_minus1 shall be equal to sps_num_subpics_minus1");
3454 }
3455 else
3456 {
3457 // When not signalled set the numer equal for convenient access
3458 setNumSubPics(sps.getNumSubPics());
3459 }
3460
3461 CHECK(getNumSubPics() > MAX_NUM_SUB_PICS, "Number of sub-pictures in picture exceeds valid range");
3462 m_subPics.resize(getNumSubPics());
3463
3464 // Check that no subpicture is specified outside of the conformance cropping window
3465 for(int i = 0; i < sps.getNumSubPics(); i++)
3466 {
3467 CHECK( (sps.getSubPicCtuTopLeftX(i) * sps.getCTUSize()) >=
3468 (sps.getMaxPicWidthInLumaSamples() - sps.getConformanceWindow().getWindowRightOffset() * SPS::getWinUnitX(sps.getChromaFormatIdc())),
3469 "No subpicture can be located completely outside of the conformance cropping window");
3470 CHECK( ((sps.getSubPicCtuTopLeftX(i) + sps.getSubPicWidth(i)) * sps.getCTUSize()) <= (sps.getConformanceWindow().getWindowLeftOffset() * SPS::getWinUnitX(sps.getChromaFormatIdc())),
3471 "No subpicture can be located completely outside of the conformance cropping window" );
3472 CHECK( (sps.getSubPicCtuTopLeftY(i) * sps.getCTUSize()) >=
3473 (sps.getMaxPicHeightInLumaSamples() - sps.getConformanceWindow().getWindowBottomOffset() * SPS::getWinUnitY(sps.getChromaFormatIdc())),
3474 "No subpicture can be located completely outside of the conformance cropping window");
3475 CHECK( ((sps.getSubPicCtuTopLeftY(i) + sps.getSubPicHeight(i)) * sps.getCTUSize()) <= (sps.getConformanceWindow().getWindowTopOffset() * SPS::getWinUnitY(sps.getChromaFormatIdc())),
3476 "No subpicture can be located completely outside of the conformance cropping window");
3477 }
3478
3479 // m_ctuSize, m_picWidthInCtu, and m_picHeightInCtu might not be initialized yet.
3480 if (m_ctuSize == 0 || m_picWidthInCtu == 0 || m_picHeightInCtu == 0)
3481 {
3482 m_ctuSize = sps.getCTUSize();
3483 m_picWidthInCtu = (m_picWidthInLumaSamples + m_ctuSize - 1) / m_ctuSize;
3484 m_picHeightInCtu = (m_picHeightInLumaSamples + m_ctuSize - 1) / m_ctuSize;
3485 }
3486 for (int i=0; i< getNumSubPics(); i++)
3487 {
3488 m_subPics[i].setSubPicIdx(i);
3489 if(sps.getSubPicIdMappingExplicitlySignalledFlag())
3490 {
3491 if(m_subPicIdMappingInPpsFlag)
3492 {
3493 m_subPics[i].setSubPicID(m_subPicId[i]);
3494 }
3495 else
3496 {
3497 m_subPics[i].setSubPicID(sps.getSubPicId(i));
3498 }
3499 }
3500 else
3501 {
3502 m_subPics[i].setSubPicID(i);
3503 }
3504 m_subPics[i].setSubPicCtuTopLeftX(sps.getSubPicCtuTopLeftX(i));
3505 m_subPics[i].setSubPicCtuTopLeftY(sps.getSubPicCtuTopLeftY(i));
3506 m_subPics[i].setSubPicWidthInCTUs(sps.getSubPicWidth(i));
3507 m_subPics[i].setSubPicHeightInCTUs(sps.getSubPicHeight(i));
3508
3509 uint32_t firstCTU = sps.getSubPicCtuTopLeftY(i) * m_picWidthInCtu + sps.getSubPicCtuTopLeftX(i);
3510 m_subPics[i].setFirstCTUInSubPic(firstCTU);
3511 uint32_t lastCTU = (sps.getSubPicCtuTopLeftY(i) + sps.getSubPicHeight(i) - 1) * m_picWidthInCtu + sps.getSubPicCtuTopLeftX(i) + sps.getSubPicWidth(i) - 1;
3512 m_subPics[i].setLastCTUInSubPic(lastCTU);
3513
3514 uint32_t left = sps.getSubPicCtuTopLeftX(i) * m_ctuSize;
3515 m_subPics[i].setSubPicLeft(left);
3516
3517 uint32_t right = std::min(m_picWidthInLumaSamples - 1, (sps.getSubPicCtuTopLeftX(i) + sps.getSubPicWidth(i)) * m_ctuSize - 1);
3518 m_subPics[i].setSubPicRight(right);
3519
3520 m_subPics[i].setSubPicWidthInLumaSample(right - left + 1);
3521
3522 uint32_t top = sps.getSubPicCtuTopLeftY(i) * m_ctuSize;
3523 m_subPics[i].setSubPicTop(top);
3524
3525 uint32_t bottom = std::min(m_picHeightInLumaSamples - 1, (sps.getSubPicCtuTopLeftY(i) + sps.getSubPicHeight(i)) * m_ctuSize - 1);
3526
3527 m_subPics[i].setSubPicHeightInLumaSample(bottom - top + 1);
3528
3529 m_subPics[i].setSubPicBottom(bottom);
3530
3531 m_subPics[i].clearCTUAddrList();
3532
3533 if (m_numSlicesInPic == 1)
3534 {
3535 CHECK(getNumSubPics() != 1, "only one slice in picture, but number of subpic is not one");
3536 m_subPics[i].addAllCtusInPicToSubPic(0, getPicWidthInCtu(), 0, getPicHeightInCtu(), getPicWidthInCtu());
3537 m_subPics[i].setNumSlicesInSubPic(1);
3538 }
3539 else
3540 {
3541 int numSlicesInSubPic = 0;
3542 int idxLastSliceInSubpic = -1;
3543 int idxFirstSliceAfterSubpic = m_numSlicesInPic;
3544 for (int j = 0; j < m_numSlicesInPic; j++)
3545 {
3546 uint32_t ctu = m_sliceMap[j].getCtuAddrInSlice(0);
3547 uint32_t ctu_x = ctu % m_picWidthInCtu;
3548 uint32_t ctu_y = ctu / m_picWidthInCtu;
3549 if (ctu_x >= sps.getSubPicCtuTopLeftX(i) &&
3550 ctu_x < (sps.getSubPicCtuTopLeftX(i) + sps.getSubPicWidth(i)) &&
3551 ctu_y >= sps.getSubPicCtuTopLeftY(i) &&
3552 ctu_y < (sps.getSubPicCtuTopLeftY(i) + sps.getSubPicHeight(i)))
3553 {
3554 // add ctus in a slice to the subpicture it belongs to
3555 m_subPics[i].addCTUsToSubPic(m_sliceMap[j].getCtuAddrList());
3556 numSlicesInSubPic++;
3557 idxLastSliceInSubpic = j;
3558 }
3559 else if (idxFirstSliceAfterSubpic == m_numSlicesInPic && idxLastSliceInSubpic != -1)
3560 {
3561 idxFirstSliceAfterSubpic = j;
3562 }
3563 }
3564 CHECK( idxFirstSliceAfterSubpic < idxLastSliceInSubpic, "The signalling order of slices shall follow the coding order" );
3565 m_subPics[i].setNumSlicesInSubPic(numSlicesInSubPic);
3566 }
3567 m_subPics[i].setTreatedAsPicFlag(sps.getSubPicTreatedAsPicFlag(i));
3568 m_subPics[i].setloopFilterAcrossEnabledFlag(sps.getLoopFilterAcrossSubpicEnabledFlag(i));
3569 }
3570}

3572const SubPic& PPS::getSubPicFromPos(const Position& pos) const
3573{
3574 for (int i = 0; i< m_numSubPics; i++)
3575 {
3576 if (m_subPics[i].isContainingPos(pos))

3578 return m_subPics[i];

3602void PPS::initRasterSliceMap( std::vector<uint32_t> numTilesInSlice )
3603{
3604 uint32_t tileIdx = 0;
3605 setNumSlicesInPic( (uint32_t) numTilesInSlice.size() );
3606
3607 // allocate new memory for slice list
3608 CHECK(m_numSlicesInPic > MAX_SLICES, "Number of slices in picture exceeds valid range");
3609 m_sliceMap.resize( m_numSlicesInPic );
3610
3611 for( uint32_t sliceIdx = 0; sliceIdx < numTilesInSlice.size(); sliceIdx++ )
3612 {
3613 m_sliceMap[sliceIdx].initSliceMap();
3614 m_sliceMap[sliceIdx].setSliceID( tileIdx );
3615 m_sliceMap[sliceIdx].setNumTilesInSlice( numTilesInSlice[sliceIdx] );
3616 for( uint32_t idx = 0; idx < numTilesInSlice[sliceIdx]; idx++ )
3617 {
3618 uint32_t tileX = tileIdx % getNumTileColumns();
3619 uint32_t tileY = tileIdx / getNumTileColumns();
3620 CHECK(tileY >= getNumTileRows(), "Number of tiles in slice exceeds the remaining number of tiles in picture");
3621
3622 m_sliceMap[sliceIdx].addCtusToSlice(getTileColumnBd(tileX), getTileColumnBd(tileX + 1),
3623 getTileRowBd(tileY), getTileRowBd(tileY + 1),
3624 getPicWidthInCtu());
3625 tileIdx++;
3626 }
3627 }
3628
3629 // check for valid raster-scan slice map
3630 checkSliceMap();
3631}
3632
3636void PPS::checkSliceMap()
3637{
3638 uint32_t i;
3639 std::vector<uint32_t> ctuList, sliceList;
3640 uint32_t picSizeInCtu = getPicWidthInCtu() * getPicHeightInCtu();
3641 for( i = 0; i < m_numSlicesInPic; i++ )
3642 {
3643 sliceList = m_sliceMap[ i ].getCtuAddrList();
3644 ctuList.insert( ctuList.end(), sliceList.begin(), sliceList.end() );
3645 }
3646 CHECK( ctuList.size() < picSizeInCtu, "Slice map contains too few CTUs");
3647 CHECK( ctuList.size() > picSizeInCtu, "Slice map contains too many CTUs");
3648 std::sort( ctuList.begin(), ctuList.end() );
3649 for( i = 1; i < ctuList.size(); i++ )
3650 {
3651 CHECK( ctuList[i] > ctuList[i-1]+1, "CTU missing in slice map");
3652 CHECK( ctuList[i] == ctuList[i-1], "CTU duplicated in slice map");
3653 }
3654}

3763 printf("}\n");
3764}

3821int ScalingList::lengthUvlc(int uiCode)
3822{
3823 if (uiCode < 0) printf("Error UVLC! \n");
3824
3825 int uiLength = 1;
3826 int uiTemp = ++uiCode;
3827
3828 CHECK(!uiTemp, "Integer overflow");
3829
3830 while (1 != uiTemp)
3831 {
3832 uiTemp >>= 1;
3833 uiLength += 2;
3834 }
3835 return (uiLength >> 1) + ((uiLength + 1) >> 1);
3836}
3837int ScalingList::lengthSvlc(int uiCode)
3838{
3839 uint32_t uiCode2 = uint32_t(uiCode <= 0 ? (-uiCode) << 1 : (uiCode << 1) - 1);
3840 int uiLength = 1;
3841 int uiTemp = ++uiCode2;
3842
3843 CHECK(!uiTemp, "Integer overflow");
3844
3845 while (1 != uiTemp)
3846 {
3847 uiTemp >>= 1;
3848 uiLength += 2;
3849 }
3850 return (uiLength >> 1) + ((uiLength + 1) >> 1);
3851}
3852void ScalingList::codePredScalingList(int* scalingList, const int* scalingListPred, int scalingListDC, int scalingListPredDC, int scalingListId, int& bitsCost) //sizeId, listId is current to-be-coded matrix idx
3853{
3854 int deltaValue = 0;
3855 int matrixSize = (scalingListId < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_4x4) ? 2 : (scalingListId < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_8x8) ? 4 : 8;
3856 int coefNum = matrixSize*matrixSize;
3857 ScanElement *scan = g_scanOrder[SCAN_UNGROUPED][SCAN_DIAG][gp_sizeIdxInfo->idxFrom(matrixSize)][gp_sizeIdxInfo->idxFrom(matrixSize)];
3858 int nextCoef = 0;
3859
3860 int8_t data;
3861 const int *src = scalingList;
3862 const int *srcPred = scalingListPred;
3863 if (scalingListDC!=-1 && scalingListPredDC!=-1)
3864 {
3865 bitsCost += lengthSvlc((int8_t)(scalingListDC - scalingListPredDC - nextCoef));
3866 nextCoef = scalingListDC - scalingListPredDC;
3867 }
3868 else if ((scalingListDC != -1 && scalingListPredDC == -1))
3869 {
3870 bitsCost += lengthSvlc((int8_t)(scalingListDC - srcPred[scan[0].idx] - nextCoef));
3871 nextCoef = scalingListDC - srcPred[scan[0].idx];
3872 }
3873 else if ((scalingListDC == -1 && scalingListPredDC == -1))
3874 {
3875 }
3876 else
3877 {
3878 printf("Predictor DC mismatch! \n");
3879 }
3880 for (int i = 0; i < coefNum; i++)
3881 {
3882 if (scalingListId >= SCALING_LIST_1D_START_64x64 && scan[i].x >= 4 && scan[i].y >= 4)
3883 continue;
3884 deltaValue = (src[scan[i].idx] - srcPred[scan[i].idx]);
3885 data = (int8_t)(deltaValue - nextCoef);
3886 nextCoef = deltaValue;
3887
3888 bitsCost += lengthSvlc(data);
3889 }
3890}
3891void ScalingList::codeScalingList(int* scalingList, int scalingListDC, int scalingListId, int& bitsCost) //sizeId, listId is current to-be-coded matrix idx
3892{
3893 int matrixSize = (scalingListId < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_4x4) ? 2 : (scalingListId < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_8x8) ? 4 : 8;
3894 int coefNum = matrixSize * matrixSize;
3895 ScanElement *scan = g_scanOrder[SCAN_UNGROUPED][SCAN_DIAG][gp_sizeIdxInfo->idxFrom(matrixSize)][gp_sizeIdxInfo->idxFrom(matrixSize)];
3896 int nextCoef = SCALING_LIST_START_VALUE;
3897 int8_t data;
3898 const int *src = scalingList;
3899
3900 if (scalingListId >= SCALING_LIST_1D_START_16x16)
3901 {
3902 bitsCost += lengthSvlc(int8_t(getScalingListDC(scalingListId) - nextCoef));
3903 nextCoef = getScalingListDC(scalingListId);
3904 }
3905
3906 for (int i = 0; i < coefNum; i++)
3907 {
3908 if (scalingListId >= SCALING_LIST_1D_START_64x64 && scan[i].x >= 4 && scan[i].y >= 4)
3909 continue;
3910 data = int8_t(src[scan[i].idx] - nextCoef);
3911 nextCoef = src[scan[i].idx];
3912
3913 bitsCost += lengthSvlc(data);
3914 }
3915}
3916void ScalingList::CheckBestPredScalingList(int scalingListId, int predListId, int& BitsCount)
3917{
3918 //check previously coded matrix as a predictor, code "lengthUvlc" function
3919 int *scalingList = getScalingListAddress(scalingListId);
3920 const int *scalingListPred = (scalingListId == predListId) ? ((predListId < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_8x8) ? g_quantTSDefault4x4 : g_quantIntraDefault8x8) : getScalingListAddress(predListId);
3921 int scalingListDC = (scalingListId >= SCALING_LIST_1D_START_16x16) ? getScalingListDC(scalingListId) : -1;
3922 int scalingListPredDC = (predListId >= SCALING_LIST_1D_START_16x16) ? ((scalingListId == predListId) ? 16 : getScalingListDC(predListId)) : -1;
3923
3924 int bitsCost = 0;
3925 int matrixSize = (scalingListId < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_4x4) ? 2 : (scalingListId < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_8x8) ? 4 : 8;
3926 int predMatrixSize = (predListId < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_4x4) ? 2 : (predListId < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_8x8) ? 4 : 8;
3927
3928 if (matrixSize != predMatrixSize) printf("Predictor size mismatch! \n");
3929
3930 bitsCost = 2 + lengthUvlc(scalingListId - predListId);
3931 //copy-flag + predictor-mode-flag + deltaListId
3932 codePredScalingList(scalingList, scalingListPred, scalingListDC, scalingListPredDC, scalingListId, bitsCost);
3933 BitsCount = bitsCost;
3934}
3935void ScalingList::processRefMatrix(uint32_t scalinListId, uint32_t refListId)
3936{
3937 int matrixSize = (scalinListId < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_4x4) ? 2 : (scalinListId < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_8x8) ? 4 : 8;
3938 ::memcpy(getScalingListAddress(scalinListId), ((scalinListId == refListId) ? getScalingListDefaultAddress(refListId) : getScalingListAddress(refListId)), sizeof(int)*matrixSize*matrixSize);
3939}
3940void ScalingList::checkPredMode(uint32_t scalingListId)
3941{
3942 int bestBitsCount = MAX_INT;
3943 int BitsCount = 2;
3944 setScalingListPreditorModeFlag(scalingListId, false);
3945 codeScalingList(getScalingListAddress(scalingListId), ((scalingListId >= SCALING_LIST_1D_START_16x16) ? getScalingListDC(scalingListId) : -1), scalingListId, BitsCount);
3946 bestBitsCount = BitsCount;
3947
3948 for (int predListIdx = (int)scalingListId; predListIdx >= 0; predListIdx--)
3949 {
3950
3951 int matrixSize = (scalingListId < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_4x4) ? 2 : (scalingListId < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_8x8) ? 4 : 8;
3952 int predMatrixSize = (predListIdx < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_4x4) ? 2 : (predListIdx < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_8x8) ? 4 : 8;
3953 if (((scalingListId == SCALING_LIST_1D_START_2x2 || scalingListId == SCALING_LIST_1D_START_4x4 || scalingListId == SCALING_LIST_1D_START_8x8) && predListIdx != (int)scalingListId) || matrixSize != predMatrixSize)
3954 continue;
3955 const int* refScalingList = (scalingListId == predListIdx) ? getScalingListDefaultAddress(predListIdx) : getScalingListAddress(predListIdx);
3956 const int refDC = (predListIdx < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_16x16) ? refScalingList[0] : (scalingListId == predListIdx) ? 16 : getScalingListDC(predListIdx);
3957 if (!::memcmp(getScalingListAddress(scalingListId), refScalingList, sizeof(int)*matrixSize*matrixSize) // check value of matrix
3958 // check DC value
3959 && (scalingListId < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_16x16 || getScalingListDC(scalingListId) == refDC))
3960 {
3961 //copy mode
3962 setRefMatrixId(scalingListId, predListIdx);
3963 setScalingListCopyModeFlag(scalingListId, true);
3964 setScalingListPreditorModeFlag(scalingListId, false);
3965 return;
3966 }
3967 else
3968 {
3969 //predictor mode
3970 //use previously coded matrix as a predictor
3971 CheckBestPredScalingList(scalingListId, predListIdx, BitsCount);
3972 if (BitsCount < bestBitsCount)
3973 {
3974 bestBitsCount = BitsCount;
3975 setScalingListCopyModeFlag(scalingListId, false);
3976 setScalingListPreditorModeFlag(scalingListId, true);
3977 setRefMatrixId(scalingListId, predListIdx);
3978 }
3979 }
3980 }
3981 setScalingListCopyModeFlag(scalingListId, false);
3982}

3984static void outputScalingListHelp(std::ostream &os)
3985{
3986 os << "The scaling list file specifies all matrices and their DC values; none can be missing,\n"
3987 "but their order is arbitrary.\n\n"
3988 "The matrices are specified by:\n"
3989 "<matrix name><unchecked data>\n"
3990 " <value>,<value>,<value>,....\n\n"
3991 " Line-feeds can be added arbitrarily between values, and the number of values needs to be\n"
3992 " at least the number of entries for the matrix (superfluous entries are ignored).\n"
3993 " The <unchecked data> is text on the same line as the matrix that is not checked\n"
3994 " except to ensure that the matrix name token is unique. It is recommended that it is ' ='\n"
3995 " The values in the matrices are the absolute values (0-255), not the delta values as\n"
3996 " exchanged between the encoder and decoder\n\n"
3997 "The DC values (for matrix sizes larger than 8x8) are specified by:\n"
3998 "<matrix name>_DC<unchecked data>\n"
3999 " <value>\n";
4000
4001 os << "The permitted matrix names are:\n";
4002 for (uint32_t sizeIdc = SCALING_LIST_2x2; sizeIdc <= SCALING_LIST_64x64; sizeIdc++)
4003 {
4004 for (uint32_t listIdc = 0; listIdc < SCALING_LIST_NUM; listIdc++)
4005 {
4006 if (!(((sizeIdc == SCALING_LIST_64x64) && (listIdc % (SCALING_LIST_NUM / SCALING_LIST_PRED_MODES) != 0)) || ((sizeIdc == SCALING_LIST_2x2) && (listIdc % (SCALING_LIST_NUM / SCALING_LIST_PRED_MODES) == 0))))
4007 {
4008 os << " " << MatrixType[sizeIdc][listIdc] << '\n';
4009 }
4010 }
4011 }
4012}
4013
4014void ScalingList::outputScalingLists(std::ostream &os) const
4015{
4016 int scalingListId = 0;
4017 for (uint32_t sizeIdc = SCALING_LIST_2x2; sizeIdc <= SCALING_LIST_64x64; sizeIdc++)
4018 {
4019 const uint32_t size = (sizeIdc == 1) ? 2 : ((sizeIdc == 2) ? 4 : 8);
4020 for(uint32_t listIdc = 0; listIdc < SCALING_LIST_NUM; listIdc++)
4021 {
4022 if (!((sizeIdc== SCALING_LIST_64x64 && listIdc % (SCALING_LIST_NUM / SCALING_LIST_PRED_MODES) != 0) || (sizeIdc == SCALING_LIST_2x2 && listIdc < 4)))
4023 {
4024 const int *src = getScalingListAddress(scalingListId);
4025 os << (MatrixType[sizeIdc][listIdc]) << " =\n ";
4026 for(uint32_t y=0; y<size; y++)
4027 {
4028 for(uint32_t x=0; x<size; x++, src++)
4029 {
4030 os << std::setw(3) << (*src) << ", ";
4031 }
4032 os << (y+1<size?"\n ":"\n");
4033 }
4034 if(sizeIdc > SCALING_LIST_8x8)
4035 {
4036 os << MatrixType_DC[sizeIdc][listIdc] << " = \n " << std::setw(3) << getScalingListDC(scalingListId) << "\n";
4037 }
4038 os << "\n";
4039 scalingListId++;
4040 }
4041 }
4042 }
4043}

4045bool ScalingList::xParseScalingList(const std::string &fileName)
4046{
4047 static const int LINE_SIZE=1024;
4048 FILE *fp = NULL;
4049 char line[LINE_SIZE];
4050
4051 if (fileName.empty())
4052 {
4053 msg( ERROR, "Error: no scaling list file specified. Help on scaling lists being output\n");
4054 outputScalingListHelp(std::cout);
4055 std::cout << "\n\nExample scaling list file using default values:\n\n";
4056 outputScalingLists(std::cout);
4057 return true;
4058 }
4059 else if ((fp = fopen(fileName.c_str(),"r")) == (FILE*)NULL)
4060 {
4061 msg( ERROR, "Error: cannot open scaling list file %s for reading\n", fileName.c_str());
4062 return true;
4063 }
4064
4065 int scalingListId = 0;
4066 for (uint32_t sizeIdc = SCALING_LIST_2x2; sizeIdc <= SCALING_LIST_64x64; sizeIdc++)//2x2-128x128
4067 {
4068 const uint32_t size = std::min(MAX_MATRIX_COEF_NUM,(int)g_scalingListSize[sizeIdc]);
4069
4070 for(uint32_t listIdc = 0; listIdc < SCALING_LIST_NUM; listIdc++)
4071 {
4072
4073 if ((sizeIdc == SCALING_LIST_64x64 && listIdc % (SCALING_LIST_NUM / SCALING_LIST_PRED_MODES) != 0) || (sizeIdc == SCALING_LIST_2x2 && listIdc < 4))
4074 {
4075 continue;
4076 }
4077 else
4078 {
4079 int * const src = getScalingListAddress(scalingListId);
4080 {
4081 fseek(fp, 0, SEEK_SET);
4082 bool bFound=false;
4083 while ((!feof(fp)) && (!bFound))
4084 {
4085 char *ret = fgets(line, LINE_SIZE, fp);
4086 char *findNamePosition= ret==NULL ? NULL : strstr(line, MatrixType[sizeIdc][listIdc]);
4087 // This could be a match against the DC string as well, so verify it isn't
4088 if (findNamePosition!= NULL && (MatrixType_DC[sizeIdc][listIdc]==NULL || strstr(line, MatrixType_DC[sizeIdc][listIdc])==NULL))
4089 {
4090 bFound=true;
4091 }
4092 }
4093 if (!bFound)
4094 {
4095 msg( ERROR, "Error: cannot find Matrix %s from scaling list file %s\n", MatrixType[sizeIdc][listIdc], fileName.c_str());
4096 return true;
4097
4098 }
4099 }
4100 for (uint32_t i=0; i<size; i++)
4101 {
4102 int data;
4103 if (fscanf(fp, "%d,", &data)!=1)
4104 {
4105 msg( ERROR, "Error: cannot read value #%d for Matrix %s from scaling list file %s at file position %ld\n", i, MatrixType[sizeIdc][listIdc], fileName.c_str(), ftell(fp));
4106 return true;
4107 }
4108 if (data<0 || data>255)
4109 {
4110 msg( ERROR, "Error: QMatrix entry #%d of value %d for Matrix %s from scaling list file %s at file position %ld is out of range (0 to 255)\n", i, data, MatrixType[sizeIdc][listIdc], fileName.c_str(), ftell(fp));
4111 return true;
4112 }
4113 src[i] = data;
4114 }
4115
4116 //set DC value for default matrix check
4117 setScalingListDC(scalingListId, src[0]);
4118
4119 if(sizeIdc > SCALING_LIST_8x8)
4120 {
4121 {
4122 fseek(fp, 0, SEEK_SET);
4123 bool bFound=false;
4124 while ((!feof(fp)) && (!bFound))
4125 {
4126 char *ret = fgets(line, LINE_SIZE, fp);
4127 char *findNamePosition= ret==NULL ? NULL : strstr(line, MatrixType_DC[sizeIdc][listIdc]);
4128 if (findNamePosition!= NULL)
4129 {
4130 // This won't be a match against the non-DC string.
4131 bFound=true;
4132 }
4133 }
4134 if (!bFound)
4135 {
4136 msg( ERROR, "Error: cannot find DC Matrix %s from scaling list file %s\n", MatrixType_DC[sizeIdc][listIdc], fileName.c_str());
4137 return true;
4138 }
4139 }
4140 int data;
4141 if (fscanf(fp, "%d,", &data)!=1)
4142 {
4143 msg( ERROR, "Error: cannot read DC %s from scaling list file %s at file position %ld\n", MatrixType_DC[sizeIdc][listIdc], fileName.c_str(), ftell(fp));
4144 return true;
4145 }
4146 if (data<0 || data>255)
4147 {
4148 msg( ERROR, "Error: DC value %d for Matrix %s from scaling list file %s at file position %ld is out of range (0 to 255)\n", data, MatrixType[sizeIdc][listIdc], fileName.c_str(), ftell(fp));
4149 return true;
4150 }
4151 //overwrite DC value when size of matrix is larger than 16x16
4152 setScalingListDC(scalingListId, data);
4153 }
4154 }
4155 scalingListId++;
4156 }
4157 }
4158// std::cout << "\n\nRead scaling lists of:\n\n";
4159// outputScalingLists(std::cout);
4160
4161 fclose(fp);
4162 return false;
4163}

4171const int* ScalingList::getScalingListDefaultAddress(uint32_t scalingListId)
4172{
4173 const int *src = 0;
4174 int sizeId = (scalingListId < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_8x8) ? 2 : 3;
4175 switch (sizeId)
4176 {
4177 case SCALING_LIST_1x1:
4178 case SCALING_LIST_2x2:
4179 case SCALING_LIST_4x4:
4180 src = g_quantTSDefault4x4;
4181 break;
4182 case SCALING_LIST_8x8:
4183 case SCALING_LIST_16x16:
4184 case SCALING_LIST_32x32:
4185 case SCALING_LIST_64x64:
4186 case SCALING_LIST_128x128:
4187 src = g_quantInterDefault8x8;
4188 break;
4189 default:
4190 THROW( "Invalid scaling list" );
4191 src = NULL;
4192 break;
4193 }
4194 return src;
4195}

4273void Slice::scaleRefPicList( Picture *scaledRefPic[ ], PicHeader *picHeader, APS** apss, APS* lmcsAps, APS* scalingListAps, const bool isDecoder )
4274{
4275 int i;
4276 const SPS* sps = getSPS();
4277 const PPS* pps = getPPS();
4278
4279 bool refPicIsSameRes = false;
4280
4281 // this is needed for IBC
4282 m_pcPic->unscaledPic = m_pcPic;
4283
4284 if( m_eSliceType == I_SLICE )
4285 {
4286 return;
4287 }
4288
4289 freeScaledRefPicList( scaledRefPic );
4290
4291 for( int refList = 0; refList < NUM_REF_PIC_LIST_01; refList++ )
4292 {
4293 if( refList == 1 && m_eSliceType != B_SLICE )
4294 {
4295 continue;
4296 }
4297
4298 for( int rIdx = 0; rIdx < m_aiNumRefIdx[refList]; rIdx++ )
4299 {
4300 // if rescaling is needed, otherwise just reuse the original picture pointer; it is needed for motion field, otherwise motion field requires a copy as well
4301 // reference resampling for the whole picture is not applied at decoder
4302
4303 int xScale, yScale;
4304 CU::getRprScaling( sps, pps, m_apcRefPicList[refList][rIdx], xScale, yScale );
4305 m_scalingRatio[refList][rIdx] = std::pair<int, int>( xScale, yScale );
4306
4307 CHECK( m_apcRefPicList[refList][rIdx]->unscaledPic == nullptr, "unscaledPic is not properly set" );
4308
4309 if( m_apcRefPicList[refList][rIdx]->isRefScaled( pps ) == false )
4310 {
4311 refPicIsSameRes = true;
4312 }
4313
4314 if( m_scalingRatio[refList][rIdx] == SCALE_1X || isDecoder )
4315 {
4316 m_scaledRefPicList[refList][rIdx] = m_apcRefPicList[refList][rIdx];
4317 }
4318 else
4319 {
4320 int poc = m_apcRefPicList[refList][rIdx]->getPOC();
4321 int layerId = m_apcRefPicList[refList][rIdx]->layerId;
4322
4323 // check whether the reference picture has already been scaled
4324 for( i = 0; i < MAX_NUM_REF; i++ )
4325 {
4326 if( scaledRefPic[i] != nullptr && scaledRefPic[i]->poc == poc && scaledRefPic[i]->layerId == layerId )
4327 {
4328 break;
4329 }
4330 }
4331
4332 if( i == MAX_NUM_REF )
4333 {
4334 int j;
4335 // search for unused Picture structure in scaledRefPic
4336 for( j = 0; j < MAX_NUM_REF; j++ )
4337 {
4338 if( scaledRefPic[j] == nullptr )
4339 {
4340 break;
4341 }
4342 }
4343
4344 CHECK( j >= MAX_NUM_REF, "scaledRefPic can not hold all reference pictures!" );
4345
4346 if( j >= MAX_NUM_REF )
4347 {
4348 j = 0;
4349 }
4350
4351 if( scaledRefPic[j] == nullptr )
4352 {
4353 scaledRefPic[j] = new Picture;
4354
4355 scaledRefPic[j]->setBorderExtension( false );
4356 scaledRefPic[j]->reconstructed = false;
4357 scaledRefPic[j]->referenced = true;
4358
4359 scaledRefPic[j]->finalInit( m_pcPic->cs->vps, *sps, *pps, picHeader, apss, lmcsAps, scalingListAps );
4360
4361 scaledRefPic[j]->poc = NOT_VALID;
4362
4363 scaledRefPic[j]->create( sps->getChromaFormatIdc(), Size( pps->getPicWidthInLumaSamples(), pps->getPicHeightInLumaSamples() ), sps->getMaxCUWidth(), sps->getMaxCUWidth() + 16, isDecoder, layerId );
4364 }
4365
4366 scaledRefPic[j]->poc = poc;
4367 scaledRefPic[j]->longTerm = m_apcRefPicList[refList][rIdx]->longTerm;
4368
4369 // rescale the reference picture
4370 const bool downsampling = m_apcRefPicList[refList][rIdx]->getRecoBuf().Y().width >= scaledRefPic[j]->getRecoBuf().Y().width && m_apcRefPicList[refList][rIdx]->getRecoBuf().Y().height >= scaledRefPic[j]->getRecoBuf().Y().height;
4371 Picture::rescalePicture( m_scalingRatio[refList][rIdx],
4372 m_apcRefPicList[refList][rIdx]->getRecoBuf(), m_apcRefPicList[refList][rIdx]->slices[0]->getPPS()->getScalingWindow(),
4373 scaledRefPic[j]->getRecoBuf(), pps->getScalingWindow(),
4374 sps->getChromaFormatIdc(), sps->getBitDepths(), true, downsampling,
4375 sps->getHorCollocatedChromaFlag(), sps->getVerCollocatedChromaFlag() );
4376 scaledRefPic[j]->unscaledPic = m_apcRefPicList[refList][rIdx];
4377 scaledRefPic[j]->extendPicBorder( getPPS() );
4378
4379 m_scaledRefPicList[refList][rIdx] = scaledRefPic[j];
4380 }
4381 else
4382 {
4383 m_scaledRefPicList[refList][rIdx] = scaledRefPic[i];
4384 }
4385 }
4386 }
4387 }
4388
4389 // make the scaled reference picture list as the default reference picture list
4390 for( int refList = 0; refList < NUM_REF_PIC_LIST_01; refList++ )
4391 {
4392 if( refList == 1 && m_eSliceType != B_SLICE )
4393 {
4394 continue;
4395 }
4396
4397 for( int rIdx = 0; rIdx < m_aiNumRefIdx[refList]; rIdx++ )
4398 {
4399 m_savedRefPicList[refList][rIdx] = m_apcRefPicList[refList][rIdx];
4400 m_apcRefPicList[refList][rIdx] = m_scaledRefPicList[refList][rIdx];
4401
4402 // allow the access of the unscaled version in xPredInterBlk()
4403 m_apcRefPicList[refList][rIdx]->unscaledPic = m_savedRefPicList[refList][rIdx];
4404 }
4405 }
4406
4407 //Make sure that TMVP is disabled when there are no reference pictures with the same resolution
4408 if(!refPicIsSameRes)
4409 {
4410 CHECK(getPicHeader()->getEnableTMVPFlag() != 0, "TMVP cannot be enabled in pictures that have no reference pictures with the same resolution")
4411 }
4412}

4414void Slice::freeScaledRefPicList( Picture *scaledRefPic[] )
4415{
4416 if( m_eSliceType == I_SLICE )
4417 {
4418 return;
4419 }
4420 for( int i = 0; i < MAX_NUM_REF; i++ )
4421 {
4422 if( scaledRefPic[i] != nullptr )
4423 {
4424 scaledRefPic[i]->destroy();
4425 scaledRefPic[i] = nullptr;
4426 }

4430bool Slice::checkRPR()
4431{
4432 const PPS* pps = getPPS();
4433
4434 for( int refList = 0; refList < NUM_REF_PIC_LIST_01; refList++ )
4435 {
4436
4437 if( refList == 1 && m_eSliceType != B_SLICE )
4438 {

4442 for( int rIdx = 0; rIdx < m_aiNumRefIdx[refList]; rIdx++ )

4445 {
4446 return true;
4447 }
4448 }
4449 }
4450
4451 return false;
4452}

4519bool operator == (const ProfileTierLevel& op1, const ProfileTierLevel& op2)
4520{
4521 if (op1.m_tierFlag != op2.m_tierFlag) return false;
4522 if (op1.m_profileIdc != op2.m_profileIdc) return false;
4523 if (op1.m_numSubProfile != op2.m_numSubProfile) return false;
4524 if (op1.m_levelIdc != op2.m_levelIdc) return false;
4525 if (op1.m_frameOnlyConstraintFlag != op2.m_frameOnlyConstraintFlag) return false;
4526 if (op1.m_multiLayerEnabledFlag != op2.m_multiLayerEnabledFlag) return false;
4527 if (op1.m_constraintInfo != op2.m_constraintInfo) return false;
4528 if (op1.m_subProfileIdc != op2.m_subProfileIdc) return false;
4529
4530 for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TLAYER - 1; i++)
4531 {
4532 if (op1.m_subLayerLevelPresentFlag[i] != op2.m_subLayerLevelPresentFlag[i])
4533 {
4534 return false;
4535 }
4536 }
4537 for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TLAYER; i++)
4538 {
4539 if (op1.m_subLayerLevelIdc[i] != op2.m_subLayerLevelIdc[i])
4540 {
4541 return false;
4542 }
4543 }
4544 return true;
4545}

4551bool Slice::isLastSliceInSubpic()
4552{
4553 CHECK(m_pcPPS == NULL, "PPS pointer not initialized");
4554
4555 int lastCTUAddrInSlice = m_sliceMap.getCtuAddrList().back();
4556
4557 if (m_pcPPS->getNumSubPics() > 1)
4558 {
4559 const SubPic& subpic = m_pcPPS->getSubPic(m_pcPPS->getSubPicIdxFromSubPicId(getSliceSubPicId()));
4560 return subpic.isLastCTUinSubPic(lastCTUAddrInSlice);
4561 }
4562 else
4563 {
4564 const CodingStructure *cs = m_pcPic->cs;
4565 const PreCalcValues* pcv = cs->pcv;
4566 const uint32_t picSizeInCtus = pcv->heightInCtus * pcv->widthInCtus;
4567 return lastCTUAddrInSlice == (picSizeInCtus-1);
4568 }
4569}
